jobs.title: Project Coordinator, ESCO
jobs.description:
**Company And Culture**



Complex is the definitive platform for global youth culture and music lifestyle, seamlessly integrating cutting\-edge content, commerce and live experiences with unparalleled scale. Through innovative content, Complex tells stories of music, streetwear and style, sports, art and beyond. Its content engages in a dynamic conversation with the audience, reflecting and shaping the zeitgeist of convergence culture. A powerful media juggernaut paired with a curated marketplace, Complex is redefining the way fans interact with their favorite brands and artists and reshaping the future of digital culture and commerce.


**Why We're Hiring**



The Project Coordinator will provide cross\-functional support to ESCO’s Brand Management and Business Development teams, helping move new partnerships and licensed products from initial opportunity through development, approval, and launch.



This person will serve as a central liaison among ESCO’s internal Product, Creative, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal teams—as well as external IP holders, record labels, artist management teams, licensors, agencies, retailers, and other partners.



The Project Coordinator will manage project timelines, partner submissions, product and creative approvals, meeting follow\-ups, asset requests, and key deliverables. The role will also support ESCO’s growing business\-development pipeline through research, presentation development, opportunity tracking, and partner coordination.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously. This is an opportunity to gain hands\-on experience across licensing, business development, brand management, product development, and go\-to\-market execution within a rapidly growing music and culture collectibles business.



The successful Project Coordinator will bring structure, visibility, and consistent follow\-through to ESCO’s partnership and product\-development processes.



Projects will have clearly defined timelines, owners, deliverables, and next steps. Partner submissions and approvals will be accurately tracked, feedback will reach the right teams, and potential delays will be identified early. The business\-development pipeline will remain organized and current, enabling leadership to make informed decisions and prioritize the strongest opportunities.



Most importantly, this person will help ESCO turn more partnership opportunities into successful products by ensuring seamless coordination from initial conversation through development, approval, and launch.

**Project and Brand Management**
* Support the Director of Brand Management in coordinating licensed\-product development from initial concept through production and launch.
* Build, maintain, and communicate project timelines, milestones, approval deadlines, launch dates, and internal deliverables.
* Coordinate project kickoffs and ensure internal teams receive the necessary deal terms, creative direction, assets, style guides, product requirements, and partner information.
* Track product concepts, card checklists, artwork, packaging, samples, marketing materials, and other project deliverables.
* Schedule project meetings, prepare agendas, capture decisions, document action items, and follow up with responsible team members.
* Identify missing information, approval delays, and other potential risks before they affect production or launch timing.
* Coordinate handoffs among Business Development, Brand Management, Product, Creative, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal.
* Support the development and maintenance of product calendars, launch trackers, approval logs, and project\-status reports.
* Help ensure that internal teams remain aligned on partner expectations, contractual requirements, product scope, and launch timing.

**Licensing and Partner Approvals**
* Serve as a day\-to\-day liaison between ESCO’s internal teams and IP holders, record labels, artist management teams, licensors, agencies, and brand partners.
* Coordinate submissions and approvals for product concepts, artwork, card designs, packaging, copy, photography, promotional materials, retail presentations, and product samples.
* Maintain detailed approval trackers showing submission dates, partner feedback, revision status, deadlines, and final approvals.
* Review submissions for completeness and accuracy before sending them to external partners.
* Consolidate partner feedback and translate it into clear, actionable direction for Product, Creative, and Marketing teams.
* Follow up with partners to keep approvals moving and escalate potential delays when necessary.
* Maintain organized records of approved artwork, assets, legal notices, logos, trademarks, style guides, samples, and approval correspondence.
* Track relevant contractual requirements, including approved product categories, territories, distribution channels, exclusivity, launch windows, talent approvals, and marketing commitments.
* Coordinate the receipt and movement of partner\-supplied materials such as photography, video, reference assets, autographs, relics, logos, and brand guidelines.

**Business Development Support**
* Support the Director of Business Development in identifying and developing new partnerships, licensing opportunities, distribution relationships, brand collaborations, and growth initiatives.
* Research prospective artists, entertainment properties, brands, licensors, retailers, distributors, and strategic partners.
* Assist with pitch decks, presentations, proposals, product concepts, meeting materials, and opportunity summaries.
* Coordinate introductory calls, partner meetings, presentations, follow\-up communications, and next steps.

jobs.title: Newborn Screening Program Specialist - Clinical Genetics
jobs.description:
**Description**  

Under the general direction of the Program Director at the UCLA Area Service Center (ASC), California Newborn Screening Program (NBS), the **Newborn Screening Program Specialist** performs a range of health reporting, administrative, programmatic, data management, and case follow\-up functions in support of statewide newborn screening activities. Responsibilities include supporting result reporting and case management for birthing providers, facilities, pediatricians, and families; maintaining accurate program data; and preparing routine and ad hoc reports using SIS, internal databases, and BI/PEP reports. Reports may include diagnosed cases, facility performance, workload activity, referrals, verifications, and other program measures. The position also develops facility\-specific reports, educational materials, newsletters, charts, and presentations using Microsoft applications, and other applicable data and reporting tools. The position provides follow\-up for positive, incomplete, inadequate, early, missed, and not\-obtained newborn screening specimens, including specimens for infants born outside of a hospital setting. Additional duties include participating in ASC assigned facility site visits, educational events/meetings, annual quality improvement and education planning/implementation, progress reporting and state improvement projects. The Program Specialist monitors newborn screening performance practices among assigned facilities and/or birthing providers, serves as a liaison to our ASC regional facilities/birthing providers, provides technical consultation when fully emerged into the program, communicates program updates and feedback to ASC facilities, leadership, and CDPH representatives as appropriate. The Program Specialist will also participate in assigned office rotation of weekend on\-call/holiday coverage on a monthly basis once reporting metrics are met.


Salary Range: $33\.81 – 53\.93 Hourly

  

Pay range: $33\.81 \- $53\.93 an hour  

  

**Qualifications** **Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
* Ability to use computer equipment, office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Access etc.) and experience in charting or case management
* Ability to fly/travel to and from GDSP All\-staff State Annual Meetings and stay overnight in a hotel as required
* Ability to work on\-call over weekends and/or holidays on occasion as assigned
* Self\-directed with ability to work independently while collaborating with an interdisciplinary team. Client/customer service focused, ability to effectively interact with pediatricians, clinics, specialty care centers and families.
* Excellent written and oral communication required. Skilled in office automation procedures.

**Preferred:**

* Licensed Certified Genetic Counselor
* Master's degree
* Experience handling/completing referrals to state agencies for pediatric providers and or hospital unit
* Ability to complete data charts in excel or other statistical software
* Capable to lead meetings with presentation with minimal supervision. Comfortable with public speaking
* Prior public health experience or knowledge of maternal child health agencies
* Team leadership experience
* Ability to communicate to and work with clinicians, families and other state agencies for patient care
* Case management/utilization management, health education and/or discharge planning experience a plus. Knowledge of CCS desired. Bi\-lingual/Spanish a plus.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator - Center for Interprofessional Education
jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE: Administrative Coordinator**

**DEPARTMENT: Center for Interprofessional Education** **REPORTS TO: Dean, Center for Interprofessional Education****LOCATION: Hybrid Remote (Whittier, California)** **FLSA STATUS: Non\-Exempt, Part\-time (20 hours per week)****RATE OF PAY: $22\.00 to $25\.00 per hour** **SUMMARY:**  

The Center for Interprofessional Education (CIPE) Coordinator plays a key role in advancing the university’s mission of preparing future health professionals for collaborative, team\-based care. This position provides comprehensive coordination for interprofessional education (IPE) activities, the Interprofessional Health Professions (IHP) courses, and the Standardized Patient (SP) program. Working in close partnership with faculty, staff, students, and external collaborators, the coordinator ensures high\-quality programming, seamless operations, and alignment with national best practices, including the Interprofessional Education Collaborative (IPEC) Core Competencies.  

The coordinator reports to the Dean of Interprofessional Education and serves as a central point of contact for IPE activities and SP operations, supporting both the strategic vision of the Center and the day\-to\-day execution of its programs. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Interprofessional Education (IPE) Coordination**

* Coordinate logistics for IPE virtual and on\-ground events, workshops, and activities across all health sciences programs.
* Manage event scheduling, registration, communications, and accurate record\-keeping.
* Serve as the primary contact for faculty and student participants in IPE activities.
* Support assessment efforts, including distribution and collection of pre\-/post\-surveys, attendance tracking, and preparation of evaluation reports.
* Collaborate with program directors and deans to align IPE activities with curricular needs, accreditation standards, and institutional outcomes.
* Provide administrative support for IPE Council and Advisory Board meetings, including scheduling, agenda preparation, minutes, archiving, and attendance tracking.
* Assist with IHP course coordination, including faculty support, assessment tracking, and course\-related communications.
* Maintain and update the CIPE website and ensure organized archiving of course and event materials.

 **Standardized Patient (SP) Program Coordination**

* Recruit, onboard, and maintain a diverse pool of standardized patients to meet institutional and programmatic needs.
* Schedule and assign SPs for IPE\-related simulations, ensuring adequate coverage and smooth execution of events.
* Track SP participation, training, and performance to ensure consistency and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with institutional policies, FERPA/HIPAA regulations, and confidentiality standards.
* Manage programmatic scheduling needs and calculate budgetary requirements for SP activities.
* Process timely payment for SPs and maintain accurate financial tracking for the SP program.
* Monitor the SP pool, documenting each SP’s strengths, areas for improvement, and training needs.
* Generate annual reports on SP utilization by program to support planning, resource allocation, and accreditation documentation.

 **Collaboration \& Communication**

* Serve as liaison between the CIPE, academic programs, and external partners to ensure alignment and shared goals.
* Maintain clear and timely communication with faculty, students, and SPs to support effective coordination.
* Foster a culture of professionalism, inclusivity, and excellence in all CIPE and SP\-related activities.

 **Evaluation \& Continuous Improvement**

* Collect, analyze, and report data from IPE and SP activities to inform continuous quality improvement.
* Provide regular reports to CIPE leadership and contribute to accreditation documentation.
* Identify opportunities for innovation and growth in IPE and SP programming in alignment with national best practices.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in education, health sciences, public health, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in program coordination, higher education, healthcare, or simulation\-based learning.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with faculty, staff, students, standardized patients, and external partners.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a diverse, fast\-paced academic environment.
* Familiarity with interprofessional education, simulation\-based training, or standardized patient methodology strongly preferred.

**NOTE:** The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the person assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, and physical demands required of personnel so classified.

 **LOCATION**:  

This position is primarily hybrid. The role requires on\-campus presence at least once per week, with additional in\-person days as needed to support essential functions such as interprofessional events, standardized patient sessions, or team\-based collaboration. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

jobs.title: Lead Clinical Research Coordinator - Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description:
Folio Clinical Research


Job: Lead Clinical Research Coordinator


Location: Los Angeles, CA (5x a week)


About Folio Clinical Research


Folio Clinical Research is a leading urologic research network treating urologic cancers, urinary stones, Peyronie’s disease, sexual and erectile dysfunction (ED), low testosterone, prostate disorders, urinary incontinence, and more. We partner with leading physician practices to create a cohesive, quality\-oriented clinical culture, facilitating best practice sharing across our platform. Our affiliated practices gain access to a broad suite of clinical trials, providing significant benefits to both physicians and patients.


Position Overview


The Lead Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) works directly under the supervision of the Principal Investigator (PI) to manage all aspects of clinical trial activities. The CRC is essential in facilitating and coordinating daily clinical trial activities, ensuring compliance, quality, and efficiency throughout the trial process. This role involves direct collaboration with the PI, sponsors, and other key stakeholders. The CRC will interact with patients during the recruitment and screening process. The CRC will also facilitate the informed consent process and provide ongoing participant support as needed.


About You:

* Experienced Clinical Research Leader: You have a proven track record in managing clinical research operations, from feasibility assessments to study close\-out.
* Operational Expertise: You have deep experience managing day\-to\-day research site operations, ensuring adherence to protocol and regulatory standards
* Mentorship Skills: You have training experience and can successfully collaborate with Principal Investigators, particularly those with minimal research experience.
* Proactive Problem Solver: You always plan ahead and are proactive about having contingency strategies in place.
* Business Acumen: You execute with a sense of urgency, maintaining a keen focus on both research objectives and business outcomes.
* Commitment to Quality and Timeliness: You manage study timelines without compromising on quality.
* Passion for Innovation: You are dedicated to bringing life\-altering treatments to market, driven by patient outcomes.
* Effective Communicator: You communicate clearly and regularly, keeping all stakeholders informed and ensuring a smooth study.
* Self\-Driven: You thrive with minimal supervision, taking ownership and responsibility for your deliverables.


Key Responsibilities:

* Regulatory and Institutional Compliance: Support the Principal Investigator and relevant departments to ensure all clinical research activities comply with federal regulations, institutional policies, and sponsor requirements.
* Documentation Management: Maintain secure and accurate storage of all study documents, including consent forms, case report forms, and investigational material records, in compliance with both sponsor and institutional requirements.
* Study Oversight: Support the PI in ensuring the study meets compliance standards, including Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals, health and safety requirements, conflict of interest disclosures, and adherence to financial terms.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Maintain regular and effective communication with Sponsors, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), and internal team members (e.g., Investigators, Nurses, Medical Assistants) to facilitate study progress.
* Meeting Participation: Engage in Site Qualification Visits (SQVs), Site Initiation Visits (SIVs), Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs), and other key study meetings as required.
* Problem\-Solving and Adaptation: Identify and anticipate potential obstacles to study timelines or deliverables, offering creative solutions to maintain momentum and study integrity.
* Inventory and Equipment Management: Manage study\-specific inventory, including identification, ordering, calibration, and secure storage of equipment required for the study.


Qualifications:

* Minimum of five years of Clinical Research Coordinator experience.
* Experience with various Electronic Data Capture (EDC), Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), and electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) systems.
* Comprehensive understanding of urology and other associated therapeutic areas, medical terminology, to effectively execute clinical trials.
* Deep knowledge of ICH\-GCP, and regulatory requirements, with the ability to implement these effectively throughout the clinical trial.
* Experience with data management processes, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of data collection, entry, and reporting, in line with Good Clinical Data Management Practices (GCDMP).
* Experience ensuring and prioritizing patient safety and data integrity, embodying a commitment to the ethical conduct of clinical trials.
* Experience maintaining the highest quality standards, while focusing on ongoing process improvements that lead to enhanced clinical trial efficiency and compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal communication, both written and verbal. Can easily interface with team members and external stakeholders. Proven ability to develop positive relationships with internal teams, physicians, and external partners.
* Strong attention to detail, and ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a dynamic research environment.
* Strong computer skills (MS Office, M PowerPoint, etc.) and software experience (CTMS, eTMF, EDC, IXRS, RTSM, etc.)
* Ability to prioritize tasks, effectively manage time, and allocate resources efficiently to meet tight study deadlines.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education/experience in science or health\-related field.

jobs.title: CCWP - Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Administrative Coordinator**


**California Coalition for Worker Power (CCWP)**  

Housed at Koreatown Immigrant Workers Alliance (KIWA)

 **About CCWP**



The California Coalition for Worker Power (CCWP) is a statewide table of worker centers, labor policy advocates, and unions advancing strategies that build durable worker power across California. Our coalition focuses on structural reforms that strengthen worker organizations, expand collective voice, and protect workers, including immigrant and Black workers, from retaliation and exploitation.California Coalition for Worker Power seeks an Interim Managing Director who understands coalition dynamics, coalition tables, operational systems and finances and can work collaboratively with CCWP leadership team, staff, and partners.

* Position Type: Full\-time, exempt
* Location: Hybrid, must be California\-based. Periodic travel to Sacramento and other in\-state locations required.
* Travel: Periodic travel to Sacramento and other in\-state locations required.
* Reports To: Policy Campaign Manager

  


**Job Description**

This role supports communication and communication protocols, manages event logistics, digital and security documentation, financial reimbursements, and day\-to\-day coordination across coalition partners, to ensure that coalition and campaign activities stay organized, timely, and aligned.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Build a Career With a Growing South Bay Real Estate Business**

South Bay Smith is looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and dependable Executive Assistant to work closely with Alex Smith and become an important part of our family\-owned residential real estate sales and property management business.

Our business is built on long\-term relationships, deep local knowledge, thoughtful strategy, integrity, and treating clients like family. The South Bay is our home, not just our market, and as we grow, we're committed to preserving the personal service and genuine relationships that have built our reputation.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who wants responsibility, not simply a list of tasks to complete. You'll become an organizational backbone of the business \- keeping priorities moving, supporting clients, bringing consistency and follow\-through to a fast\-moving workday, and gradually taking ownership of increasingly important areas of the company.

As our Executive Assistant \& Client Experience Coordinator, you'll also help make sure every client feels informed, cared for, and confidently guided through what comes next.

If you're the person who naturally brings order to a busy environment, remembers the details, follows through, and takes satisfaction in making things easier for both clients and the people around you, you may be exactly who we're looking for.

**What You'll Do**

**Executive Support \& Organization** 

* Manage Alex's calendar, scheduling, priorities, reminders, email organization, and follow\-up. Keep deadlines, commitments, and next steps visible and moving forward.
* Anticipate what needs attention, resolve loose ends, and create structure around a busy workday that moves between clients, properties, negotiations, meetings, and new opportunities.
* Help protect Alex's time so he can focus on clients, relationships, negotiations, pricing strategy, and business development.
* Maintain organized systems and improve recurring processes so important information and commitments don't depend on memory alone.

**Client Experience \& Real Estate Support** 

Provide warm, professional, responsive support to clients throughout the sales and property management experience.

Coordinate appointments, meetings, showings, inspections, vendors, and other real estate activities.

Assist with transaction administration, documentation, signatures, deadlines, and follow\-up.

Help clients understand what comes next and ensure communication is timely and thoughtful.

Help create a calm, organized client experience even when things become complicated or fast\-moving.

Marketing, Client Engagement \& Community

Assist with mailings, community activities, marketing projects, and relationship\-building initiatives.

Create polished, dynamic social media and digital content that reflects the South Bay Smith brand, captures attention, and stops the scroll.

Turn property photos, video, local knowledge, client stories, and ideas into compelling finished content efficiently, using good judgment about where time and effort will have the greatest impact.

Support email marketing, print materials, presentations, and other marketing initiatives.

Bring creative ideas for staying connected with past clients, reaching new clients, and strengthening our presence in the community.

**Who We're Looking For**

* The right person doesn't need to know everything about real estate on day one. What matters most is how you work. You'll be a strong fit if you naturally keep track of details others miss, enjoy bringing order to a busy environment, and take satisfaction in making sure things actually get done.
* Are exceptionally organized, detail\-oriented, reliable, and able to follow through without repeated reminders.
* Think ahead, take initiative, and know when to handle something yourself, when to follow up, and when to bring something to Alex's attention \- while respectfully helping keep priorities on track.
* Are resourceful and self\-directed \- you can take a rough idea or desired outcome, figure out what's needed, and move it toward a polished finished product without step\-by\-step direction.
* Can quickly prioritize competing demands based on deadlines, client impact, and importance while staying calm and organized.
* Communicate early, close the loop, and bring solutions whenever possible \- including facts, options, and a recommendation when Alex's judgment is needed.
* Are an excellent written and verbal communicator who can represent Alex and South Bay Smith warmly and professionally.
* Exercise excellent judgment, discretion, and confidentiality, and stay flexible and solution\-oriented when plans change.
* Are technologically fluent, work efficiently across digital platforms, and adapt quickly to new systems.
* Have strong creative and visual instincts, produce polished and engaging content efficiently, and know how to balance quality with speed.
* Enjoy improving systems, want to learn and earn increasing responsibility, and understand that working in a small business sometimes means stepping outside your usual responsibilities to help with an unexpected task or fill a gap when something needs to get done.
* Local South Bay candidates are strongly preferred. We value someone who knows the area, understands the communities we serve, and feels genuinely connected to the South Bay.

**Experience**

Real estate experience is a plus, but not required. Strong candidates may come from executive or administrative support, business operations, client service, project coordination, marketing/content creation, or another role requiring excellent organization, judgment, and follow\-through.

We're also interested in what else you bring to the table. Maybe you have a great eye for social media and marketing, are exceptionally good at creating systems, are naturally strong with clients, or have another capability that could make a growing small business better.

About the role
  
The TikTok LIVE Automotive team partners with top global automotive brands and their dealer networks to unlock live streaming as a new customer acquisition and lead generation channel. This role owns a portfolio of headline automotive KA (Key Account) brands end\-to\-end: co\-designing joint annual and campaign budgets, building the go\-live playbook with brand HQ and local dealers, driving live streaming quality and lead conversion on the ground, and turning early KA wins into scalable case studies that lift the whole automotive vertical. The goal is not more livestreams, it is real business outcomes (leads, test drives, orders) that make TikTok LIVE a must\-have channel for automotive marketing.
  
  

What you'll do
  
* KA account ownership: Own a portfolio of headline global automotive brands (OEMs and their dealer groups) as the primary TikTok LIVE point of contact, build multi\-level relationships across brand marketing, digital, retail, and agency stakeholders, and land TikTok LIVE inside their annual marketing and digital plan.
* Joint budget \& business planning: Co\-develop annual and campaign\-level budgets with each brand (media spend, live streaming activation, dealer subsidies, creator collaboration), align on KPIs (leads, CPL, test drives, showroom traffic, orders), and secure written commitments and quarterly business reviews.
* Live streaming guidance: Provide hands\-on coaching on live streaming strategy, content structure, host / dealer sales talent selection, live room setup, product demo scripts, interaction and lead\-capture mechanics, and use of live streaming and lead tools, so brand and dealer live rooms consistently hit quality and conversion benchmarks.
* Campaign execution: Design and land integrated campaigns around new car launches, auto shows, seasonal moments, and always\-on dealer live streaming, working with in\-app product entries, ads, creators, and offline events.
* Customer success \& LIVE ROI: Track full\-funnel performance (impressions, viewership, leads, CPL, dealer handoff, test drive, order), diagnose gaps, and iterate playbooks so each KA brand can prove positive live streaming ROI and renew / expand budget.
* Dealer \& creator ecosystem: Coordinate brand HQ, regional offices, country subsidiaries, dealer groups, and automotive creators into one live streaming operating model, and turn top\-performing dealers and creators into references that pull in the long tail.
* Playbook \& case sedimentation: Turn winning campaigns into repeatable automotive live streaming playbooks (by segment: mass\-market/NEV/used\-car, by market, by campaign type), and lead knowledge transfer to sales, dealer, and cross\-market teams.
* Cross\-functional collaboration: Work closely with sales, product, ads, creator, data, and governance teams to unblock KA needs, feed automotive\-specific requirements back into product and ad solutions, and represent the automotive industry point of view internally.


Qualifications
  
  

Minimun Qualification(s)
  
* Bachelor's degree or above, with 5\+ years of automotive\-industry experience in one of the following backgrounds: (1\) automotive KA / brand partnership / sales roles at OEMs, dealer groups, automotive agencies, or automotive media / marketing platforms; (2\) prior experience at a leading Chinese automotive brand's global / overseas business.
* Solid understanding of the global automotive brand and dealer ecosystem: how OEMs, regional offices, dealer groups, 4S stores, and automotive agencies work together on marketing budget, leads, and sales funnel.
* Hands\-on live streaming operations experience: able to guide a brand or dealer live room end\-to\-end, from content and host to interaction mechanics, lead capture, and conversion optimization.
* Strong commercial and budget sense: comfortable co\-owning annual budget conversations with senior brand and agency stakeholders, and defending the plan with data and ROI.
* Data\-driven: able to build a full\-funnel automotive metric system (impressions → viewership → leads → test drive → order), read data to find problems, and validate operations with experiments and control groups.
* Strong cross\-functional and project\-driving skills, comfortable coordinating brand, dealer, agency, product, ads, creator, and data stakeholders in parallel.
* Working proficiency in English, able to collaborate directly with overseas automotive brands, dealers, and internal teams and passionate about the automotive industry, live streaming, and creator economy, and willing to stay close to frontline brands, dealers, and live rooms.


Preferred Qualification(s)
  
* Prior experience at an OEM, dealer group, automotive agency, or automotive vertical of a major internet / e\-commerce / live streaming platform.
* Familiarity with automotive lead management and CRM systems, and with how leads are handed off from platform to dealer to sales.
* Experience running new\-car launch, auto show, or large\-scale automotive marketing campaigns across online and offline channels.
* Experience operating in multiple markets (US, EU, MENA, SEA, LATAM) or working with global brand HQ and local dealer networks in parallel.

jobs.title: Service Sales Representative
jobs.description:
The Services Sales Representative creates, advances, and closes profitable service opportunities across our customer base and target markets. The role turns hardware\-led conversations into complete operational outcomes: identifying customer needs, shaping the right service solution, coordinating technical scoping, and guiding opportunities from discovery through contract handoff.  

The mandate is to grow recurring and project\-based services revenue and increase service attachment to product sales, without sacrificing delivery quality, gross margin, or customer expectations. The right candidate is a disciplined consultative seller who can translate complex drone, autonomy, security, training, compliance, and support capabilities into clear business value. **Responsibilities:** ***Pipeline \& Opportunity Ownership**** Build and maintain a qualified services pipeline through outbound prospecting, account expansion, product\-sales collaboration, marketing leads, referrals, partners, and industry events.
* Identify opportunities to attach services to drone, dock, payload, robotics, software, and ArgusLine trailer sales.
* Qualify on business need, operational readiness, technical fit, budget, authority, timing, and risk.
* Own follow\-up cadence, stakeholder mapping, and progression through defined CRM stages.

 ***Discovery \& Solution Development**** Lead structured discovery into use cases, sites, workflows, performance expectations, compliance constraints, and purchasing process.
* Translate needs into the right service pathway, engaging services leadership or technical specialists when deeper scoping is required.
* Develop statements of work, proposals, estimates, and customer presentations using approved offerings, pricing rules, and templates.
* Manage pricing and negotiation within approved authority, protecting target margin and escalating nonstandard terms or delivery risk.

 ***Cross\-Functional Selling \& Handoff**** Partner with product sales early so the customer gets a deployment\-ready solution rather than a hardware\-only transaction.
* Coordinate technical discovery, site assessments, demonstrations, and pilots with the right subject\-matter experts.
* Complete a documented sales\-to\-delivery handoff covering scope, assumptions, contacts, schedule, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and open risks.
* Stay commercially engaged after kickoff to support customer communication, change orders, renewals, references, and additional service adoption.

 ***CRM, Forecasting \& Discipline**** Keep CRM records complete and current: value, stage, close date, products and services, stakeholders, activities, risks, and next action.
* Submit reliable weekly forecasts, identify pipeline gaps early, and execute corrective prospecting.
* Follow approved contracting, pricing, discount, legal review, data handling, export\-control, and aviation compliance processes.

 ***Services Portfolio***
You will become conversant across our services portfolio and know when to bring in a specialist: implementation and professional services, managed autonomy and remote operations, BVLOS readiness and ComplianceOps, role\-based training, support and care programs, data services including mapping, inspection, thermal and LiDAR, and ArgusLine mobile security trailer services. **Qualifications:** ***Required**** Three or more years of B2B consultative sales, solutions sales, or professional services sales. Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered.
* Experience selling services, managed services, technical support, training, consulting, or complex solutions involving multiple stakeholders.
* Able to run discovery, qualify opportunities, build a business case, develop proposals, and negotiate to close through a structured process, with attention to commercial and scope detail.
* Able to learn technical concepts quickly and explain them to operational and executive audiences.
* Willing to travel for customer meetings, site visits, demonstrations, and industry events.

 ***Preferred**** Experience in commercial drones, autonomous systems, robotics, physical security, public safety, industrial inspection, energy, or aviation.
* Familiarity with drone\-in\-a\-box deployments, remote operations, mapping or inspection workflows, aviation compliance, or technical training.
* Experience selling through product\-sales teams, channel partners, integrators, or public\-sector procurement.
* FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate, or willingness to obtain it within a mutually agreed period after hire.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative Manager - Hair & Wig Ind
jobs.description:
**About LaVivid**

LaVivid is a premium hair system brand focused on providing natural, high\-quality solutions for men experiencing hair loss. We specialize in non\-surgical hair replacement systems that are designed to look realistic, feel comfortable, and fit seamlessly into everyday life.

Our products are trusted by customers worldwide and are widely used by professional salons and stylists. We work closely with salon partners to deliver not only great products, but also reliable support, consistent quality, and a smooth ordering experience.

With a strong presence in the U.S. market, LaVivid is actively expanding its local salon network and building long\-term partnerships. Our goal is to create a supportive ecosystem where salons can grow their business while helping clients regain confidence.

At LaVivid, we value professionalism, responsiveness, and genuine relationships. We believe that strong partnerships and great service are just as important as the products we provide.

**Role Overview**

In this role, you'll be the face of LaVivid in the U.S. — managing our showroom, building relationships with salon partners, planning local events, and representing our brand at industry gatherings. You'll work closely with our headquarters team while having the autonomy to shape how we grow in the U.S. market.

If you're someone who thrives on building connections, creating memorable brand experiences, and working hands\-on in a fast\-paced environment, this is the role for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Develop and expand LaVivid's professional partner network across the United States

* Build and strengthen relationships with existing salon partners, distributors, and professionals.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities to expand LaVivid's offline partner network.

2\. Plan and execute offline brand events

* Organize and actively participate in Open House events, Pop\-up events, educational workshops, and hands\-on training sessions.
* Build a stronger local community while attracting new professional partners and customers.
* Support product demonstrations during customer visits, events, and training sessions.

3\. Manage the LaVivid Showroom

* Handle showroom appointments and customer consultations.
* Help customers select the most suitable products based on their needs.
* Coordinate hair model appointments and support content creation, including before\-and\-after transformations, product demonstrations, and educational videos.
* Maintain the daily operation and presentation of the showroom to ensure a professional customer experience.

4\. Represent the LaVivid brand

* Serve as a professional brand ambassador in the U.S. market.
* Build trust and long\-term relationships within the hair replacement industry.
* Represent LaVivid at industry events and networking opportunities.

5\. Share market insights

* Collect customer feedback and market intelligence.
* Work closely with the headquarters team by providing insights on customer needs, industry trends, and competitor activities to support continuous improvement.

**What We're Looking For**

Industry experience – Background in hair systems, beauty, salon, or related industries is a strong plus.

Relationship builder – You genuinely enjoy connecting with people and nurturing long\-term partnerships.

Self\-starter – You're comfortable working independently and taking ownership of your territory.

Hands\-on – Willing to get involved in showroom operations, events, and customer consultations.

Communicator – Comfortable engaging with salon partners, clients, and cross\-functional teams in English.

**Why Join LaVivid?**

Make an impact – You'll have real ownership over U.S. market growth and the freedom to bring your own ideas to life.

Grow with us – We're expanding fast. This role offers room to grow into broader leadership positions as we scale.

Be part of a supportive team – We're a collaborative, no\-ego group that values creativity, integrity, and mutual respect.

**Compensation**

Hourly base pay \+ commission. The estimated annual compensation range of $60,000–$100,000 reflects total earning potential based on base pay and commission, depending on individual sales performance.

*LaVivid is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We look forward to learning more about you!*

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

In this role, you will identify potential clients, build early relationships with key decision\-makers, and create qualified opportunities for the Account Executive team.


This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, goal\-oriented environment and is interested in building a successful career in sales.

* Partner with sales and marketing teams to improve outreach efforts and support pipeline growth.

jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant \- (CEO, COO and CIO)**
**Position Type:** Full Time, exempt employee
**Salary Range:** $80,000 \- $85,000, annually, DOE. Compensation will be based on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
**Location:** This position based onsite at the Service Center in **San Juan Capistrano, CA**

**About the Company:**
Ensign Services, Inc. (“ESI”) is a subsidiary of The Ensign Group, Inc. whose affiliated entities are considered national leaders in the fast\-growing post\-acute care industry. ESI provides service and support to more than 396 affiliated operations across the post\-acute care continuum, which collectively employs more than 55,000 people.
ESI is known as the “Service Center” and provides the facilities and leaders it serves with specialized support in areas such as accounting, construction, compliance, human resources, information technology, learning and development, legal and risk management and recruiting. This structure allows the onsite leaders and caregivers to focus on day\-to\-day care and operational issues in their individual operations. What sets ESI apart from other companies is the quality of our most valuable resource \- our people.
We take our core values of **Celebration**, **Accountability**, **Passion for Learning**, **Love One Another**, **Intelligent Risk Taking**, **Customer Second**, and **Ownership** (“CAPLICO”) seriously. We want an individual in this role who will demonstrate these values through actions and words.
**About the Opportunity**
We are seeking a highly capable, thoughtful and proactive **Executive Assistant** to provide primary administrative support to our CEO, COO and CIO. Based in our South Orange County Service Center in San Juan Capistrano, the Executive Assistant will interact with all departments within the Service Center and operations..
**What You’ll Do**
==================


* Strong calendar management skills and ability to prioritize many competing requests with minimal guidance.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings including scheduling, agendas, briefing materials, logistics, technology, catering and follow\-up.
* Plan detailed travel, including air, hotel, ground transportation and itineraries.
* Serve as a professional point of contact for employees, affiliated leaders and external partners.
* Prepare and organize executive correspondence, presentations, reports, meeting materials and other confidential documents.
* Maintain meeting notes and assist with follow\-up items, proactively maintaining momentum and closing communication gaps.
* Anticipate upcoming needs by monitoring priorities, deadlines, travel, meetings and organizational activities.
* Partner closely with other Executive Assistants and Service Center teams to coordinate leadership meetings, events, and special projects.
* Support internal meeting coordination with discretion, accuracy and appropriate follow\-through.
* Manage expense reports, invoices, and other administrative processes in a timely and accurate manner.
* Support established administrative processes and workflows.
* Provide occasional support outside regular business hours for travel or scheduling needs.

**What You’ll Bring**
=====================


* At least 3\-5 years of administrative or executive support experience.
* Strong organizational, scheduling and travel coordination skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including confidence communicating with senior executives and external stakeholders.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to learn new technology and systems quickly.
* Outstanding attention to detail and a consistent record of producing accurate, polished work.
* Sound judgment and demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information.
* A proactive, service\-oriented mindset with the ability to anticipate needs, take ownership and work independently with minimal supervision.
* Ability to learn and adapt to the differing priorities, communication styles and working preferences of different leaders.
* A collaborative approach and demonstrated ability to build strong working relationships with other Executive Assistants and leadership teams.
* Strong interpersonal skills, emotional maturity and the ability to build trust across a decentralized organization.
* Composure, flexibility and resourcefulness when priorities shift or unexpected issues arise.
* Experience planning executive meetings and leadership events.
**Additional Information**
Any offer of employment may be contingent upon the successful completion of job\-related post\-offer requirements, which may include background checks, reference checks, and/or other screenings or examinations as permitted by applicable law.
**What We Offer**  

We are committed to providing a competitive benefits and compensation package which includes medical/dental/vision coverage, company\-provided life insurance, 401(k) with company match, and sick/vacation plans. Additionally, enjoy access to our fully equipped onsite gym (San Juan Capistrano office location). We also believe in supporting our employee’s professional growth and development through our Learning Management System as well as training sessions and seminars. Take a look at these benefits (and more!) at www.ensignbenefits.com
This company is an equal opportunity employer. *If you need assistance or accommodation during the application process, please contact us at 888\-659\-3616\.*

jobs.description:

With a network of over 140 service centers across the USA, Canada, UK, UAE, India, and China, we serve more than 60,000 customers, including some of the world's most renowned brands.  

  

Our team of approximately 1,400 employees is committed to delivering top\-class customer service across diverse industries such as retail, sports, entertainment, fitness, construction, education, healthcare, and technology. **Riot Creative Imaging** (www.riotcolor.com), our specialized visual color graphics division, excels in transforming spaces through immersive environmental graphics and sustainable printing solutions. As a certified minority\-owned company operating since 1990, ARC is proud of its heritage and unwavering commitment to quality and innovation.  

**Who we are looking for:**
We are looking for an **Assistant Project Coordinator \& Estimator** to support our digital print production team. The successful candidate is someone who enjoys working in a print environment. The primary duties include coordinating the print production cycle, combining technical cost analysis with project scheduling. This role calculates material, and machine costs to help create bids, while overseeing print job flow, acting as the liaison between clients and production teams, and ensuring quality standards are met.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Schedule and perform site surveys as needed
* Prepare accurate cost estimates, quotes, and pricing based on project specifications
* Review scope of work, materials, labor requirements, and production timelines
* Assist in managing projects from order entry through delivery
* Coordinate with Regional Color Manager, Project Manager, and production to ensure deadlines are met
* Customer communication regarding specifications, timelines, revisions, approvals, and updates
* Create and maintain IFP quotes, work orders, and production documentation
* Monitor print production progress, installation progress, and flag issues that may impact schedule or cost
* Interface with customers regarding scheduling, problem\-solving, job status, quotes, solutions
* Provide other forms of customer service as required
* Verify accurate files, specifications, and production requirements prior to release

* Tracking multiple active jobs simultaneously while maintaining attention to deadlines and detail
* Follow up on customer approvals, proofs, and production stages
* Assist in coordinating delivery schedules and installation logistics
* Assist in resolving production, quality, or delivery issues as they arise
* Work in conjunction with Project Manager to maintain project flow and customer satisfaction
* Help prioritize urgent jobs and adjust schedules as needed based on production demands
* Assist in site surveys
* Effectively communicate with customer to understand scope of work and make recommendations when needed during on site survey/job site
  

**Estimating**  

* Interpret customer specifications, drawings, and bid documents to develop pricing through IFP
* Calculate material usage, labor, finishing, freight and outside vendor costs
* Request vendor pricing when needed for outsourced services or specialty material
* Ensure estimates align with company pricing standards and margin expectations
* Revise estimates as project scope changes
* Assist in preparing bid responses and proposal documentation

* Excellent communication and customer service skills
* Ability to work under fast paced environment with strict deadlines
* Experience in large format color print production, graphics, signage, or related industry preferred
* Proficiency in estimating, order entry, and Microsoft Office systems
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite – Adobe Acrobat Professional, Illustrator, Photoshop
* Attention to detail and problem\-solving mindset

  

**Pay range:** $23\.00 to $28\.85 per hour, depending on experience.  

  

**ARC \| Riot** offers comprehensive health benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with a match, Company\-Paid Life Insurance, and an array of voluntary benefits which include STD, LTD, Voluntary Life, PTO, PEDs, employee Recognition Programs, Spot Awards, and more!

jobs.title: OCIP Workers Compensation Program Coordinator, Google Data Centers
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Healthcare, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* 2 years of experience handling workers compensation claims.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience with claims management systems, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS) platforms, and standard productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets).
* Solid working knowledge of end\-to\-end workers compensation procedures, claims administration, and relevant state and federal labor laws.
* Comprehensive understanding of medical terminology, treatment protocols, and injury evaluation.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Workers Compensation and Owner Controlled Insurance Policy (OCIP) Program Lead oversees the strategic governance, placement, and daily administration of owner\-controlled insurance programs and occupational injury claims. This role drives end\-to\-end risk management by conducting exposure analyses, directing policy audits, and partnering closely with brokers and contractors to optimize coverage structures and ensure seamless program enrollment.


In addition to program strategy, the lead directs full\-lifecycle workers compensation claims management across employees, owners, and contractors. Acting as the primary liaison among injured workers, insurance carriers, legal counsel, and healthcare providers, the role coordinates quality medical care and facilitates prompt, modified\-duty return\-to\-work transitions. Furthermore, the position ensures regulatory compliance and workplace safety by delivering supervisor training, maintaining comprehensive claims databases, and analyzing incident trends to implement proactive, data\-driven injury prevention initiatives.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead end\-to\-end insurance placement and strategic risk mitigation across all operations. Manage data processing for policy placement, oversee policy audits, analyze program structures, and direct enrollments with OCIP brokers and contractors.
* Receive and process claims for owners, employees, and contractors, arrange medical care and facilitate return\-to\-work and modified\-duty accommodations.
* Serve as primary contact for injured workers, liaise with carriers, clinics, and legal counsel and maintain detailed incidents and financial records.
* Deliver supervisors claim training, analyze incident trends to prevent recurring injuries, and ensure alignment with workers compensation regulations.
* Evaluate risk exposures, design proactive risk control solutions, and build strategic vendor and insurer relationships.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience
* Experience writing scientific correspondence
* Excellent verbal and written communications and presentation skills ; excellent organizational skills; and excellent interpersonal skills to work effectively in a diverse team

* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-based environment; project management and coordination skills; ability to prioritize tasks and meet multiple deadlines on concurrent projects.
* Ability to establish cooperative working relationships with patients, co\-workers, \& physicians.
* Ability to work independently, exercising judgment and initiative
* Detail oriented, self\-motivated and a record of exceptional performance meeting multiple deadlines for concurrent projects
  

Preferred Qualifications:


* MRI brain imaging experience

* Demonstrated proficiency with medical terminology

* Ability to abstract data from medical records and transfer it to data collection forms or directly into databases
* Experience performing statistical analysis
* Experiences preparing IRB submissions and helping with grant/manuscript preparation
* Experience analyzing data using statistical software

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator - Bilingual English and Chinese
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

A fast\-growing Educational Tech Company 7EDU's mission is to guide and support K\-12 students through all types of challenges, preparing them to exceed their current capabilities for success in academics and beyond.

We are looking for someone who has a great passion for online education and is committed to growth and excellence to join our core team members.

This position will allow you to experience the day\-to\-day Operations of our Marketing team, you participate in team collaboration, branding and Marketing planning/execution.

**Position Summary**

We are looking for a bilingual Marketing \& Social Media Coordinator to create engaging content, manage social media channels, support marketing initiatives, and help grow our brand presence across online and offline channels.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and manage bilingual (English \& Chinese) marketing content, including videos, graphics, social media posts, and promotional materials.
* Manage and maintain the company's social media presence across platforms such as LinkedIn, Facebook, Xiaohongshu (RED), WeChat Video Channel.
* Monitor and report on marketing performance, including content engagement, audience growth, lead generation, and campaign effectiveness.
* Support livestreams, webinars, podcasts, and other digital marketing initiatives.
* Coordinate and execute community events, school fairs, workshops, and partner activities.
* Maintain website content and support SEO efforts to improve online visibility and user engagement.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support marketing campaigns, branding initiatives, and business development activities.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Bilingual in English and Chinese, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in CapCut and Canva.
* Experience managing social media platforms.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Creative mindset with an eye for design, content storytelling, and audience engagement.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with Odoo, Wix, Google Workspace, Zoom, and digital marketing tools.
* Experience in education, community engagement, event marketing, or related industries.
* Basic understanding of SEO principles and website content management.
* Familiarity with marketing analytics and social media performance reporting.

Pay: $25\.00 per day

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
Logistics Operations Coordinator – Robotics

**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Locations:** Mountain View, CA  
**Positions Available:** 2

**Mountain View:** On\-site attendance required  
**Cambridge:** Remote working can be considered; candidates must be available to work Eastern Time (ET) hours

About the Opportunity

We are supporting a world\-leading advanced technology organization to expand its Logistics Operations function within a cutting\-edge **robotics, engineering and R\&D environment**.

We are seeking Logistics Operations Coordinators to take ownership of the day\-to\-day movement of specialist equipment, components, materials and other assets required by technical teams.

This is a hands\-on operational logistics position where accuracy, organization and reliable execution are critical. You will manage shipments from initial request through to final delivery, ensuring appropriate documentation is in place, processes are followed and stakeholders have clear visibility throughout.

You will work closely with robotics and laboratory teams, internal operations functions, suppliers and logistics partners to ensure equipment and materials reach the right location safely, compliantly and on time.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the day\-to\-day logistics pipeline, coordinating shipments from initial request through to final delivery.
* Coordinate the domestic and international movement of specialist equipment, components and materials supporting robotics, engineering and R\&D activities.
* Act as a key operational point of contact for internal robotics, engineering and laboratory teams requiring shipments.
* Gather accurate shipment requirements and ensure all necessary information is captured prior to dispatch.
* Coordinate with internal teams, suppliers, freight providers and other external partners.
* Obtain and maintain accurate shipping documentation, including commercial invoices, customs information and relevant regulatory paperwork.
* Ensure shipments are processed in line with established internal procedures and applicable customs and legal requirements.
* Track shipments throughout the delivery lifecycle and provide clear, timely updates to stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate shipment records and logistics data using spreadsheets, tracking tools and internal systems.
* Proactively identify potential delays, documentation gaps, compliance issues and other risks that could impact delivery.
* Escalate bottlenecks and operational issues to the Logistics Manager to support rapid resolution.
* Identify recurring issues or areas of non\-compliance within the logistics pipeline.
* Support a fast\-paced technical environment where the timely availability of equipment and materials is critical to ongoing robotics and engineering programs.

Experience \& Skills

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and highly organized logistics professional who is comfortable taking ownership of multiple shipments and priorities.

You should have:

* Previous experience in logistics, shipping, supply chain coordination or a similar process\-driven operational role.
* Practical knowledge of domestic and/or international shipping processes.
* Experience working with shipping documentation, including commercial invoices, shipping terms and customs documentation.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly when handling shipping documentation and operational data.
* Experience working within established processes, policies and compliance requirements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A proactive approach to identifying and escalating issues.
* Experience with spreadsheets, data entry, shipment tracking tools or logistics systems.
* The ability to operate effectively within a fast\-paced, global environment.

Desirable Experience

Experience within one or more of the following environments would be particularly valuable:

* Robotics and automation
* Engineering and advanced technology
* Research \& Development
* Laboratory or technical facilities
* Electronics and hardware
* Aerospace or automotive
* Manufacturing or industrial technology
* Scientific or research organizations

Experience coordinating **high\-value, specialist, technical or sensitive equipment** would also be advantageous.

The Environment

This is not a traditional high\-volume warehouse or distribution role.

You will be supporting specialist robotics, engineering and R\&D teams that rely on the efficient movement of technical equipment, components and materials.

The role requires someone who can combine strong logistics fundamentals with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to operate effectively in a highly technical, fast\-moving environment.

Pay: $26\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: CLIENT EXPERIENCE & MARKETING COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
ABOUT HARMONIA PILATES

Harmonia Pilates is a new boutique reformer Pilates studio opening in San Francisco’s Richmond District. We offer strength\-focused, progressive movement in a refined but welcoming environment.

Our values—Strength, Balance and Community—guide everything from our classes to the way each client is welcomed into the studio.

THE ROLE

We are looking for an organized, creative and outgoing Client Experience \& Marketing Coordinator to manage the front desk while helping build Harmonia’s local presence and online community.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys connecting with people, creating engaging social content and helping a growing brand come to life. It is a hands\-on position combining client service, studio operations, marketing and content creation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

CLIENT EXPERIENCE AND FRONT DESK

* Welcome clients and create a warm, polished studio experience
* Assist clients with bookings, memberships, class packages and account questions
* Manage check\-ins, waitlists, cancellations and basic booking\-system updates
* Keep the reception, retail and common areas organized and presentation\-ready
* Build genuine relationships with clients and support member retention
* Assist with studio events, workshops and community partnerships

MARKETING AND SOCIAL MEDIA

* Help plan and manage Harmonia’s Instagram and other social\-media channels
* Capture photo and video content in the studio
* Create and edit Reels, Stories, posts and short\-form videos
* Write captions and schedule content using Harmonia’s brand voice
* Share studio updates, instructor introductions, educational content and client stories
* Promote memberships, introductory offers, events and workshops
* Help manage the studio’s content calendar
* Support email newsletters and local marketing campaigns
* Identify partnership opportunities with neighborhood businesses and community groups
* Monitor engagement, inquiries and campaign results
* Ensure all content reflects Harmonia’s visual and verbal brand standards

MEMBERSHIP SALES

* Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective members and leads
* Respond promptly to phone calls, emails, text messages, website inquiries, and social media leads
* Conduct studio tours and consultations that create an exceptional first impression
* Learn each prospect's goals, lifestyle, and needs to recommend the most appropriate membership or services
* Confidently present membership options, pricing, promotions, and studio offerings
* Ask for the sale while providing a comfortable, consultative experience
* Follow up consistently with prospective clients throughout the decision\-making process

LEAD MANAGEMENT

* Maintain an organized sales pipeline within the studio's CRM or management software.
* Track inquiries, appointments, conversions, and follow\-up activities.
* Ensure every lead receives timely and personalized communication.
* Monitor lead sources and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.
* Maintain accurate records and sales notes.

QUALIFICATIONS

* At least \[1–2] years of experience in customer service, hospitality, fitness, retail, marketing or social media
* Strong understanding of Instagram, Reels and short\-form content
* Experience with Canva and basic photo or video editing tools
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Friendly, composed and confident working directly with clients
* Highly organized and able to move between operational and creative tasks
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through
* Comfortable learning booking, point\-of\-sale and email\-marketing platforms
* Interest in Pilates, fitness or wellness strongly preferred
* Availability for some early mornings, evenings and weekends

WHO YOU ARE

* You are naturally warm and make people feel welcome
* You have a strong visual eye and understand what makes content engaging
* You are proactive and notice what needs to be done
* You communicate clearly and professionally
* You are dependable, resourceful and comfortable working independently
* You enjoy being part of a growing business and neighborhood community

POSITION DETAILS

* Position: Part\-time, approximately \[20–30] hours per week
* Location: Harmonia Pilates, Richmond District, San Francisco
* Compensation: $30\-35 per hour, depending on experience
* Benefits and perks: Complimentary classes, retail discounts and opportunities to grow with the studio

TO APPLY

Please send your resume and a brief introduction explaining why you would be a great fit for Harmonia Pilates to contact@harmoniapilates.co. Please also include examples of social\-media accounts, posts, videos or other content you have created, if available.

Harmonia Pilates is an equal\-opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our team and community.

Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
This is an exciting opportunity to work for one of the top law firms in the U.S.! Davis Wright Tremaine LLP is looking for an **Office Administrative Coordinator** to join our team in our **San Francisco** office.


We offer a hybrid work engagement with one day of remote work, and four days in\-office.


This position is responsible for providing administrative support to the Office Administrator, Operations Supervisor and Legal Assistant Manager(s), including day\-to\-day processing of various administrative matters, typing correspondence, managing calendars and sending meeting invitations, taking meeting notes, sending reminders, keeping track of vendor documents/contracts terms, assisting with special projects/events and tasks, and additional support as assigned.


At Davis Wright Tremaine, you will find challenging assignments, opportunities for professional growth and community involvement, and a culture of inclusion. DWT fosters inclusiveness and authenticity. Regardless of position, everyone here has a voice and the support is unparalleled.

**On a typical day you will:**

* Act as central communication and information hub and representative of the office management team
* Attend various office administrative meetings and record notes/reminders, circulate and maintain notes/reminders as needed
* Coordinate and act as primary office contact for public transportation monthly passes
* Organize and coordinate various special vendor programs including support staff coaching and student internships
* Maintain and track office credit card charges and back\-ups, reconcile charges and prepare appropriate expense reports
* Partner and coordinate with firm legal staff and attorney recruiting teams to deliver onboarding coordination including orientation schedules, office setups and events for new staff and attorney hires, including Summer Associates
* Serve as liaison and secondary point of contact for building management and office vendors; submit vendor invoices for payment
* Coordinate with Operations Supervisor to maintain and update internal directories, floor plans and contact lists as needed
* Assist with planning and execution of office projects and programs, including IT (Information Technology) rollouts, client and community service events, office special events, client meetings and professional development initiatives
* Work with Office Administrator, Operations Supervisor and Legal Assistant Manager(s) to track spending for various department budgets including business development, client development/entertainment, sponsorships, travel, staff development, etc.

**Join us if you have:**

* 3\+ years of administrative assistant or similar experience is preferred
* High level of confidentiality
* Solutions driven and can\-do attitude
* High level of emotional intelligence and ability to flex to different personalities
* Approachable and friendly demeanor
* Helpful attitude with high level of customer service focus
* Creative thinking with ability to partner/collaborate with others in the office
* Ability to organize assignments; work under pressure and meet deadlines
* Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with lawyers, managers and staff
* High attention to detail and excellent organization skills
* Ability to communicate clearly and work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong computer skills with a knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel is required; knowledge of all MS Office products strongly preferred
* Accounting and legal marketing experience is preferred; experience in a professional services organization is a plus

**Who We Are**


Davis Wright Tremaine LLP is an AmLaw 100 law firm with 9 offices nationwide. We are relentlessly committed to client service and look for candidates who share that commitment. At DWT, client service means having empathy for each client’s and each lawyer’s work and personal pressures, business objectives, and legal needs; anticipating their needs; and having the capabilities and commitment to deliver what matters most to them.

 **What’s in it For You?**


DWT offers competitive compensation in addition to ample benefits including but not limited to:

* Choice of health and vision insurance plans
* 2 paid volunteer days for qualifying community service work
* Dental plan
* Fertility and adoption benefit
* Paid sabbatical after 13 years of service
* Tuition reimbursement
* Commuter benefits
* Retirement contribution


This job description intends to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to include all duties and responsibilities.

 **California**


The annualized salary range for this position in San Francisco is $72,000 to $83,000 ($36\.92 to $42\.56 hourly). Actual pay will be adjusted based on experience and other job\-related factors permitted by law. Full time employees may be eligible for a bonus, health insurance with an optional HSA, long term disability, dental insurance, vision care, telemedicine and virtual short term solution based counseling services, life insurance, Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, subsidized backup care and caregiving resources, 401(k), vacation, sick time, and an employee assistance program. Additional voluntary programs include: voluntary accident insurance, voluntary life, voluntary disability, voluntary long term care, and pet insurance. Commuter and Transit programs are also available.
