jobs.title: Office & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Office \& Operations Coordinator


OUR MISSION


Our mission is to inspire and empower all young people to take control of their future.


OUR VISION


We envision a world where everyone has access to an equitable path to success.


POSITION SUMMARY


The Office \& Operations Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day administrative and operational functions of Roads to Success, Inc. This position serves as a consistent in\-person presence at the organization’s office and helps ensure that the workplace is organized, welcoming, functional, and prepared to support staff, visitors, meetings, and organizational activities.


The Coordinator is expected to demonstrate strong situational awareness, sound judgment, and the ability to anticipate the needs of a busy office environment. This includes monitoring activity in and around the office, assisting staff and visitors as they enter and exit the workplace, coordinating conference room usage and meeting logistics, maintaining office supplies, and ensuring that shared spaces are prepared and properly maintained.


In addition to office coordination, the position provides cross\-functional operational support, including assistance with invoicing, billing documentation, expense tracking, vendor coordination, and other administrative functions that support the organization’s business operations.


ORGANIZATIONAL ROLE


Department: Operations / Administration
  

Reports To: Chief Administrative Officer or Designee
  

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.
  

Hours: 25 hours per week


Rate:$27/HR
  

Work Arrangement: Fully in\-person at RTS headquarters
  

Classification: Part\-time, non\-exempt
  

Union Status: Non\-union
  

Benefits: This position is not eligible for RTS’s standard employee benefits package, subject to applicable plan terms and legally required benefits or leave.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES


Office \& Front\-Office Coordination


* Maintain a professional, welcoming, organized, and functional office environment.
* Serve as a consistent point of contact for staff, visitors, vendors, and guests entering the office.
* Maintain awareness of staff and visitor activity in and out of the workplace.
* Greet and assist visitors and direct them to the appropriate staff member or department.
* Receive and distribute mail, packages, deliveries, and other incoming materials.
* Respond to general office inquiries and direct questions or requests to the appropriate staff member.
* Monitor common areas and identify office needs or issues that require attention.
* Maintain overall office housekeeping and organization including kitchen upkeep, and general tidiness.
* Assist with maintaining office supplies and ensuring commonly used materials are available.
* Help ensure that shared office areas remain organized and ready for daily use.

Meeting \& Organizational Support


* Monitor the daily conference room schedule and help prevent scheduling conflicts.
* Provide logistical and administrative support for staff, leadership, Board of Directors, committee, and other organizational meetings.
* Prepare meeting spaces, materials, refreshments, technology, and other logistical arrangements as requested.
* Coordinate room readiness before meetings and restore meeting spaces following meetings.
* Support occasional organizational events and meetings occurring outside the employee’s regular schedule.
* Anticipate meeting\-related needs and communicate any concerns or logistical issues promptly.

Office Facilities \& Supplies


* Help maintain a clean, organized, and productive office environment.
* Monitor office supplies and communicate replenishment needs.
* Report office maintenance, equipment, or facility concerns to the appropriate staff member.
* Assist with troubleshooting minor office issues, including printers, copiers, postage equipment, and other common office equipment.
* Maintain awareness of office safety, functionality, and general appearance.

Administrative \& Operations Support


* Provide general administrative support to the Operations team and other departments as assigned.
* Assist with preparing, organizing, scanning, copying, filing, and maintaining documents and records.
* Assist with internal meetings, organizational events, and other activities requiring administrative or logistical support.
* Maintain organized administrative records and documentation.
* Support the development and maintenance of efficient administrative processes.
* Identify routine operational needs and communicate them to the Chief Administrative Officer or designee.
* Provide administrative support for special projects and organizational priorities as assigned.

Invoicing, Billing \& Cross\-Functional Operations Support


* Provide administrative support related to organizational invoices and billing.

The Department of Social Services (DSS) is comprised of the administrative units of the New York City Human Resources Administration (HRA) and the Department of Homeless Services (DHS). The Office of the Ombudsman provides independent and impartial assistance to OHS clients and provides the public with access to a wide array of information and services.
  

  

The DSS Ombudsman staff responds to constituent concerns and inquiries. The Community Coordinator will visit shelters to meet with shelter management and residents and conduct presentations regarding what the Office of the Ombudsman can help them with.

* Aid constituents who contact the Office of the Ombudsman on issues relating to homelessness (through phone, email, walk\-ins, correspondence), by addressing the concerns raised, researching cases as comprehensively as needed to thoroughly understand their concerns raised, and working with appropriate internal and external partners to achieve a successful resolution.

  

* Provide supportive client experience through effective and compassionate listening and timely client\-focused case management. Provide direct counseling and/or outreach services. Refer to other public agencies or community resources as needed.

### **About Magma Math**


Magma is one of the world’s fastest\-growing and most celebrated edtech companies, transforming math education. Our platform turns handwritten solutions into digital insights, empowering teachers to focus on creativity and deeper learning — while giving them real\-time visibility into student progress.


The result? More inclusive, engaging, and effective math classrooms for all learners.


But we’re not just building better tools. We’re tackling one of the biggest challenges in global education: math underperformance. With 1 in 5 students globally struggling in math — a subject that forms the backbone of so many career paths — we believe the opportunity to improve outcomes at scale is massive.


We’re already the go\-to solution in thousands of schools — and we’re just getting started. As we expand rapidly across the U.S. and Europe, we’re building a team as ambitious as our mission: to help millions of students unlock their full potential in math.

### **The role**


We're looking for a writer who already knows K–12 education from the inside, and who wants to spend their day diving into good math instruction.


Maybe you taught math and kept a blog nobody asked you to write. Maybe you coached teachers, built curriculum, sat in a central office, or spent years in edtech close enough to real schools that you still know what goes wrong in a Tier 2 block. However you got here, you'll be writing multiple pieces a week for the people who decide what happens in a district's math classrooms.

### **What you'll write**

* Blog posts and articles. The core of the job. The audience can be a math coach interested in a specific problem of practice: why students who can compute still can't explain, what to do when your intervention block isn't moving the needle, how to run a "same but different" routine with real student work. The audience can also be district leadership keeping up with the trends of screen time in the classroom, safe AI implementation, and more.
* One\-pagers. Tight, genuinely useful documents our team hands to districts. An implementation timeline. What the first three weeks of teacher adoption actually look like. How our approach differs from answer\-checking platforms.
* Campaign copy support. Emails and social posts, often built from something you already wrote.
* Additional assets as needed. Conference materials, a case study, a PD handout, talking points for our sales team, a landing page rewrite. Over time there's room to host webinars, join podcasts, and take on longer research reports that pull results from several districts into one evidence piece.

### **What we're looking for**

* Real K–12 experience, from any direction. Teaching or instructional coaching. Curriculum writing or instructional design. A district or state role in teaching and learning, assessment, or intervention. An edtech career spent close to schools, in implementation, professional learning, customer success, product, or content. Math backgrounds have a head start, and we're glad to talk with strong candidates from other subjects.
* Writing you can show us. Blog posts, a newsletter, curriculum documents, PD materials, a Substack, a conference deck, a program evaluation. It doesn't need to be marketing writing. We're looking for writing where you made an argument and someone read it.
* A comfortable working pace. Two to three finished pieces a week, sustainably, with an editor in your corner.
* Range across registers. A piece for a math coordinator and a piece for a superintendent can make the same argument and share almost no sentences. If you've briefed a board, presented to a cabinet, or worked with proficiency and adoption data, tell us about it.
* Fluency with the language of the work. Productive struggle, vertical alignment, fidelity, discourse, number sense, as things you've watched succeed or fall apart in real life.

#### **What we offer**

* Play a key role in an exciting journey. We are a young company with ambitious targets and meaningful goals
* Fantastic colleagues in a fun environment with great opportunities to learn
* Competitive remuneration \& benefit package
* Annual company trip
* An opportunity to work on a meaningful mission and have an exceptional impact on education, society and how children learn math across the world  

‍

**Start**: As soon as possible

**Salary**: The salary range for this full\-time role is $85k\-$100k per year. Actual compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience, skill level, and location.

**Office location**: NYC

**Note:** We practice a 4\-day in office policy, and we look forward to working together closely with you.

jobs.title: Apparel and Promotional Product Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
A to Z Media is seeking a detail\-oriented Apparel \& Promotional Product Development Coordinator. In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone of our merchandise department, executing and tracking product development, logistics, and vendor coordination for a diverse roster of music and brand clients.  

  

This role will focus on the seamless execution of merchandise programs, from initial start to final delivery. This role is ideal for a proactive, highly organized individual with a passion for music who thrives on cross\-functional collaboration, precise timeline management, and hands\-on problem solving.  

  

**What You’ll Do**  

  

**Product Development \& Timeline Tracking**  

  

\- Production Tracking \- manage the day\-to\-day product lifecycle, tracking items through the design, proofing, manufacturing, and final delivery stages  

\- Art Trafficking \- work closely with the internal Art Department to route design assets and proofs, ensuring client approvals are secured and accurate  

\- Schedule Maintenance \- maintain an up\-to\-date production calendar and generate weekly status reports to ensure all open projects stay on schedule  

\- Quality Control \- monitor pre\-production samples for quality issues, coordinate client approvals, and flag any discrepancies immediately  

  

**Vendor \& Sourcing Coordination**  

  

\- Vendor Liaison \- serve as a point of contact for our global vendor network to secure pricing, proofs, production timelines, and shipping methods  

\- Order Administration \- issue accurate Purchase Orders (POs) to vendors, confirm receipt, and monitor vendor portals for completion dates  

\- Sourcing Support \- assist in researching and vetting new vendors and manufacturers to expand apparel and promotional product options  

  

**Client Services \& Communication**  

  

\- Account Management \- maintain regular, clear communication (via email, Slack, Zoom, and phone) with clients, managers, and sales teams regarding job statuses  

\- Asset Creation \- assist in compiling internal pitch decks and monthly recaps showcasing newly developed products  

\- Issue Resolution \- act as a responsive point of contact for client claims, following established procedures to correct production or delivery errors swiftly  

  

**Logistics, Data, \& Order Administration**  

  

\- Database Accuracy \- maintain accurate and real\-time records of milestones, production notes, and shipping details within our custom database  

\- Financial Administration \- generate and issue accurate client invoices upon project completion; coordinate VAT and domestic sales tax billing with the finance team  

\- Inventory \& Warehouse Coordination \- liaise with the warehouse team to coordinate incoming shipments, pickups, physical inventory counts, and product reworks  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

\- Experience \- 2 \- 4 years of relevant experience in product coordination, apparel production, account \- management, or merchandise operations  

\- Industry Knowledge \- direct experience working within an apparel, promotional products, or music merchandise environment is highly preferred  

\- Project Management \- proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment  

\- Communication \- exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both business executives and creative artists/managers  

\- Adaptability \- high comfort level working in a dynamic environment, with a "can\-do" attitude and a knack for proactive problem\-solving  

  

**Key Skill Set**  

  

\- Extreme Attention to Detail \- inherent focus on follow\-through, database accuracy, and order precision  

\- Cross\-Functional Collaboration \- ability to act as a seamless bridge between sales, art, logistics, accounting, and external partners.  

\- Logistical Aptitude \- understanding of shipping, tracking, warehousing, and production workflows  

\- Creative Alignment \- a strong eye for product quality and design, combined with a genuine passion for music culture and artist branding.  

  

Founded in 1994, A to Z Media is a family\-owned company specializing in Vinyl, CD, DVD, Promotional Product and Apparel, and Manufacturing Services. For over 30 years, we have been committed to delivering exceptional customer service, high\-quality products, and competitive pricing for our global clientele. We work closely with clients to provide bespoke manufacturing solutions, including special printing, packaging, production, and logistical support. Our clients range from indie labels and branding agencies to distributors and Fortune 500 companies. At A to Z Media, we pride ourselves on being a true partner in bringing creative visions to life.  

  

Full\-Time, Onsite to Hybrid, $45,000 \- $65,000

jobs.title: Associate Account Manager - Remote
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

  

Boyd Thermal by Eaton is looking for an enthusiastic Associate Account Manager to join our sales team and focus on driving growth with existing and new customers for our Industrial Solutions sector. In this role, you will be a critical point person driving our efforts to continue our strong growth trajectory. Key elements will be to support the leader of this sector in maintaining strong customer relations and drive growth with existing customers.


To ensure success in this role, you should have a passion for building customer relationships, highly collaborative and the ability to seek out and develop new opportunities. Ultimately, a top\-class Inside Sales professional drives revenue growth by understanding the needs of the customer and helping to develop solutions with the right product offerings.


Base compensation is $70,000 \- $100,000 depending upon education and experience. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

**Responsibilities**

* Drive revenue growth for the Industrial Solutions sector
* Work directly with customers to support and manage business growth by developing strong relationships with operating departments and various management levels.
* Develop new business and forge new relationships with the cross functional organizations at potential customers.
* Develop and execute strategies for increased customer penetration by selling additional products and services to all customer divisions.
* Set strategic goals and tactical plan to achieve significant growth and build on the culture of achieving those goals within a high success/high reward environment.
* Directly engage at customer locations to win incremental business through active business development. Requires establishing strong relationships with various management levels.
* Work closely with customer engineers and purchasing to ensure product and design requirement are identified. Work closely with Boyd Thermal Engineering to manage the design and development of customer solutions.
* Display and demonstrate products and solutions using prototypes, samples and marketing support materials, providing value added guidance to customers. Utilizing knowledge of materials and manufacturing processes, illustrates and emphasizes Boyd Themal’s value\-added propositions.
* Manage the quotation process. In conjunction with the Sales Operations Team, performs technical review of engineering drawings and specifications, gathers and prepares required information for formal quotation including, but not limited to, drawings, sample parts, technical data, volumes, and material sources for submittal to Boyd Thermal Estimating. Manages the preparation of formal quotation packages with pricing to maximize revenue, while also maximizing Gross Margin.
* In conjunction with the Sales Operations Team, monitors and manages progress of projects in order to successfully meet customers’ milestones and production schedules, from inception to implementation.
* Engage with customers on all commercial topics including credit and shipping terms, legal requirements, payments, and so forth. Manages aspects of the relationship per terms and conditions of agreements, as well as negotiating new agreements in conjunction with Boyd management. Responds when necessary to special customer needs or complaints.
* Utilizes Salesforce CRM package daily to capture all business opportunities, customer business intelligence, wins and losses. Uses this and other tools to frequently and transparently communicate opportunities and current state to colleagues and management.

**Qualifications:**

**Basic (Required) Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree
* A minimum of two (2\) years of experience in account management, customer success, and/or client services creating quotes and proposals for a manufacturing company.
* No relocation benefit is offered for this position. Candidates may be located anywhere within the United States.
* Boyd Thermal by Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F\-1 to H\-1B, H\-1B cap registration, O\-1, E\-3, TN status, I\-485 job portability, etc.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in a manufacturing environment that is multi\-piece manufacturing from design to manufacture. Custom manufacturing.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Production, and Sales.

**Position Criteria:**

* Data Analysis: Ability to analyze metrics and extrapolate a practical solutions and recommendations.
* Negotiation: Ability to communicate and deliver a value proposition; broker relevant deals and deliver a win\-win oriented solution for the business and the customer.
* Project Management: The ability to manage your task flow and complete assignments on time.
* Communication: Ability to deliver written and oral communications in constructive and concise manner.
* Travel: Willingness and ability to travel to meet objectives. Travel will be relatively limited.
* Customer focused: Demonstrates through action, that external and internal customers are the highest priority. Anticipates, understands and delivers the customer expectations with the highest quality and sense of urgency
* Business Savvy: A strategic thinker who is disciplined and exhibits a strong understanding of the business, its financial commitments, customers, competitive environment and other key metrics. Effectively uses data to make sound business decisions and proposals.
* Innovation/Creativity: Boldly champions and embraces continuous improvements through new and creative ideas. Open minded, courageous and challenges the status\-quo to improve the business.
* Execution Excellence: Ensures operations excellence and actions that are based on a sound business strategy. Consistently delivers strong business results

jobs.description:
**About the company:**


Securitas Healthcare empowers caregivers to deliver connected, productive, and safe care. Our innovative portfolio of solutions helps hospitals, clinics, and senior living organizations protect people, use their assets efficiently, and understand their operations for a caring and healing environment. With deep roots in healthcare and a commitment to our customers’ long\-term success, we are proud to work with over 15,000 providers worldwide across the care continuum. For more information, visit us at securitashealthcare.com. We need the best people to help us deliver on that mission. People who are inspired by our vision. People with individual imaginations, perspectives, and experiences. People who don’t just join us but add to us.

**Position Summary****:**


Responsible for growing a pre\-assigned book of business as well as prospecting for new accounts, presenting Securitas Healthcare solutions, closing the business, and managing the account after the initial sale to ensure continued revenue growth. The customers for this role are nationwide but heavily based in the Midwest and South.

* This role includes both base salary and variable compensation. The compensation range provided represents total target compensation.
* This role requires approximately 50% to 60% travel and is fully remote when not traveling.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Grow sales and establish, manage, and maintain relationships with named IDN’s while effectively communicating information regarding these accounts to all applicable parties internally and externally
* Responsible for sales to assigned accounts including, but not limited to, inbound/outbound telephone calls to and from clients and prospects, on\-site meetings with targeted corporate/national accounts, and ongoing account maintenance for established accounts
* Recommend which use cases should be targeted, based on earning potential, estimating the time and resources necessary to obtain material sales from the account
* Hold (at minimum) annual business reviews with clients to gauge level of satisfaction and to align with client goals for the future
* Effectively manage support and maintenance renewals to receive PO’s on time
* Establish and maintain key relationships at the corporate level with all assigned accounts
* Attend trade shows and network with potential national accounts as required
* Assure quality in the company’s response to needs and expectations with respect to order processing, reporting, and other matters
* Work with all departments in the company concerning government accounts and help move orders through the company smoothly.
* Work together with Client Executives and their RBD’s to build a strategy to effectively create and uncover opportunities in named accounts from a top down/bottom\-up perspective
* Effectively work with our Authorized Service Providers (ASP’s) where applicable to plan and manage deployments and assure proper support is provided.
* Keep all pertinent people informed of any problems or important issues concerning the accounts
* Develop action plans and successfully obtain contracts and sales from the accounts targeted in the plans
* Update and analyze information on each current account; be knowledgeable of client solutions in place that aligns with our solutions
* Track and create meaningful information on current accounts by developing a strategic plan to promote growth and execute
* Assist in mentoring Client Executives and Account Mangers to hone sales skills
* Develop and execute a strategic plan to promote growth within territory
* Engage in problem solving and make decisions and recommendations as appropriate
* Travel as necessary to meet the goals of the company through attendance at trade shows, client sites, national account visits, etc.
* Other duties as assigned
**Required Qualifications:**

* College degree in Business or Marketing or equivalent combination education and work experience in these areas required.
* 5\-7 years of sales experience required; business to business
* 2 plus years of experience of managing corporate sales accounts
* Sales experience in healthcare required
* Successful track record managing a growing account portfolio \& sales territory
* The right individual will be self\-motivated, with a high energy level what will take the initiative to research, make decisions, follow through on and accomplish multiple tasks with a sense of vision, detail, commitment, priority and urgency
* Must be a leader with demonstrated selling and relationship building capabilities that enjoys a challenge
* Must possess above\-average oral and written communication abilities, and strong interpersonal skills
* The ability to present products and information to key high\-level people required
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word is essential
* Physically capable of setting up and tearing down trade show booths and demo kits, may require lifting up to 50 lbs.
* Valid Driver’s license and a good driving record is required
* Must have the ability to travel at 50%\-60% of the time.

**To Excel:**

* Experience managing and partnering with Group Purchasing Organizations (GPOs).
* Background in building and scaling Real\-Time Location Services (RTLS) pipelines and solutions.
* Proven success working with Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs) and hospital systems, navigating complex healthcare procurement and stakeholder environments.
**Position Title:** National Account Manager, Acute

**Supervisor’s Title:** Sr Director, National Accounts

**Department Name:** Sales

**FLSA Status:** Exempt, Full\-time, M\-F

**EEO Statement:** We are a nationwide provider of security solutions, and an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. Our core values of Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness are proudly demonstrated daily by our employees to our customers and the communities we service.

PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk\-adjusted returns.

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Company :**  

Cogent Communications is a multinational, Tier 1 facilities\-based ISP, consistently ranked as one of the top five networks in the world and is publicly traded on the NASDAQ Stock Market under the ticker symbol CCOI. Cogent specializes in providing businesses with high speed Internet access, private network services, IPv4 address leasing, optical transport services and data center colocation services. Cogent's facilities\-based, all\-optical IP network backbone provides IP services in over 228 markets globally. Since its inception, Cogent has unleashed the benefits of IP technology, building one of the largest and highest capacity IP networks in the world. This network enables Cogent to offer large bandwidth connections at highly competitive prices. Cogent also offers superior customer support by virtue of its end\-to\-end control of service delivery and network monitoring. Structured tenure pay increases and an uncapped commissions plan offers you unlimited earnings potential.
  
  

**Compensation:**  

**\[Starting / Initial] Base Salary Pay Range:** \[$19\.23\- $24\.03 per hour or $40,000 – $50,000 per year].
  
  

**Commission:** Commissions are earned on each sale based on product type:
  
  

50% \-150% of one month’s MRCs (monthly recurring charges)
  
  

1/12 of one\-time NRCs (non\-recurring charges) \&
  
  

1/24 of Burst
  
  

**\[Tenured] Base Salary Pay Range:** \[$19\.23 \- $36\.05 per hour or $40,000 \- $75,000 per year] based on achievement of structured tenure based and performance based pay increases.
  
  

Specific offers within the listed pay ranges are determined by a variety of factors such as experience, education, skills, certifications and business needs.
  
  

**Responsibilities :**  

Identify new business opportunities within a prescribed Regional Sales Territory via sourcing and prospecting efforts through a high volume of direct calling and emailing efforts.
  
  

Strategize with your Sales Management team on how to sell into your region’s largest commercial and retail buildings, office parks, and professional campuses.
  
  

Compliment prospecting and selling efforts with fieldwork such as building walks, lobby events, property management relationships, and customer face\-to\-face meetings.
  
  

Learn how to understand a customer’s need and then educate them on the connectivity solutions that Cogent can provide to them via consultative and relationship\-building selling techniques.
  
  

Consistently update your efforts in our Customer Relationship Management system.
  
  

Achieve targeted monthly revenue goals.
  
  

**Qualifications :**  

0\-2\+ years of solid, sales experience.
  
  

Strong oral and written communication skills are a must.
  
  

Ability to work in a fast\-paced, team environment with revenue deadlines.
  
  

Working knowledge of computer applications such as Microsoft Office and software applications.
  
  

**Work Environment :**  

This is an in\-office position five days a week to best support your success, allowing for focused mentorship, training, and personal coaching.
  
  

By submitting an application or resume for this position, I understand that is an in\-office position.
  
  

To apply for the Regional Account Manager position, please submit your resume and cover letter to careers@cogentco.com .
  
  

Cogent Communications is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  

\#LI\-DNI

 **Quality Assurance \& Continuous Improvement**

* Adhere to all Health \& Safety policies and procedures

Amazon Advertising operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of digital advertising solutions with the goal of helping consumers find and discover products and services. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About** **monday.com**
========================


monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000\+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership\-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition.

  

**About the Role**
==================


We’re looking for a highly motivated Sales Development Representative to play a pivotal role in generating qualified leads and building a robust pipeline for our sales team. You’ll be responsible for proactively reaching out to ideal prospects, qualifying their needs and pain points, and setting valuable appointments with the Account Executives team. This is a results\-oriented position where your proactive and creative/strategic approach, excellent communication skills, and industry knowledge will be key to your success.

* **Open doors.** Take a data\-driven approach to prospecting that builds a pipeline across key customer segments, while building connections and establishing monday.com's brand in markets we will be entering soon.
* **Take extreme ownership.** Identify and actively address inefficiencies: we need to leverage our tools for prospecting at speed
* **Qualification:** Conduct deep\-dive discovery calls to understand prospect needs, challenges, and budget. Uncover potential buying signals and pain points to determine fit with our solutions.
* **Meeting preparation:** Prepare detailed call reports and qualification summaries for AEs, including key contact information, company background, and potential deal size.
* **CRM management:** Accurately and consistently update CRM with prospect data, call notes, and meeting outcomes.
* **Reporting and analysis:** Track and analyze your activity and performance metrics, identify areas for improvement, and share insights with management.
* **Continual learning:** Stay updated on industry trends, competitor landscape, and company offerings to effectively engage and qualify prospects.

**Requirements**
================

* Minimum 1 year of experience in Outbound sales and/or lead generation
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and engage prospects in meaningful conversations.
* Excellent time management and organizational skills, adapt at multitasking and prioritizing effectively.
* Proficient in CRM software and data analysis tools (preferably Salesforce)
* Passion for learning and a continuous improvement mindset.
* Competitive spirit and drive to exceed quota and win deals. Self\-starter, goal oriented
* Possess a comprehensive understanding of monday.com solution and connect that knowledge directly to customer ROI
* Develop strategies and coordinate cross\-functional support to help customers maximize the value from the monday.com solutions
* Proven ability to identify and overcome sales objections.
* Self\-starter, goal\-orientated, and customer\-centric

**What** **monday.com** **can offer you:**

* Join a customer\-obsessed team where transparency and ownership are how we actually operate \- not just things we put on a wall.
* Work on a multi\-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide
* Competitive salary, benefits, bonus potential, and equity eligibility for many roles — we believe people who build the product should share in its success
* Grow fast through a dedicated L\&D team, AI workshops, bootcamps, and internal hackathons \- the industry moves quick and so do we
* A collaborative, global culture backed by Employee Resource Groups and workplace teams across New York, Tel Aviv, London, Munich, Warsaw, Tokyo, Sydney, and more

  

The estimated annual base salary range for this role is $75,000 \- $85,000\. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including education, training, experience, business needs, and work location. In addition to base salary, employees are eligible for either an annual discretionary bonus or a role\-based, sales incentive plan. Certain roles may also include equity in the form of RSUs. Full compensation details, including any applicable bonus or incentive plan, will be provided in the hiring process.


monday.com offers a competitive benefits package, including comprehensive medical/dental/vision insurance, generous paid time off (vacation, holidays, personal leave and sick leave), fully paid parental leave, automatic 401(k) contributions, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount (ESPP), and more. Full benefits details are available upon request. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis with no set deadline.


Compensation Range: $75K \- $85K

jobs.description:

This pivotal role is essential to fueling our sales pipeline by identifying and engaging with potential customers through strategic outbound efforts. We're seeking someone who can combine deep knowledge of lending operations and financial technology with excellent communication skills to engage and drive decision\-makers in the lending industry to explore our solution.


As an SDR at Hypercore, you will be the first touchpoint for prospects, carefully qualifying leads based on predefined criteria and setting up meetings for the CEO to close. * **Strategic Execution:** Coordinate qualified meetings, manage follow\-ups, maintain CRM records, and adapt strategies based on market feedback and industry trends.
* **Cross\-functional Excellence:** Work with marketing to align messaging, while leveraging industry knowledge and emerging technology trends to improve outreach effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

* **Drive:** Highly motivated with a strong desire to contribute to the company’s growth and success.
* **Proven Success:** Demonstrated ability to generate and qualify leads, meeting performance goals in a data\-driven sales environment.
* **Experience:** 2\-3 years of experience in sales development or enterprise sales, particularly in SaaS or technology\-focused industries. Experience in niche sectors, including FinTech, is a plus.
* **Industry Knowledge:** Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles and familiarity with technology adoption in B2B financial services environments.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling outreach messages and build relationships with key decision\-makers.
* **Analytical Skills:** Experience using data to assess and improve outreach strategies, with proficiency in CRM and sales tools.
* **Adaptability:** Ability to pivot quickly in response to changes in industry trends, feedback, and market dynamics.

* Join a start\-up with an incredibly fun and exciting culture, backed by leading investors.
* Amazing opportunity for professional growth. Young company, allowing you to be empowered and trusted to make impactful decisions and think strategically.
* Attractive compensation package including early\-stage equity/stock options
* Flexible working arrangements

* **Competitive compensation:** $60K–$65K base \+ uncapped commission (OTE: $90K–$100K)
* **Equity:** Early\-stage stock options, giving you the opportunity to share in Hypercore’s success
* **Health coverage:** Fully paid health insurance for you and your spouse
* **Paid time off:** 20 days of PTO plus 7 days of paid sick leave annually
* **Retirement benefits:** Access to a 401(k) plan

If you possess these qualities and are excited about the opportunity to join an early\-stage startup and make a significant impact on its success, we encourage you to apply.

* 2–4 years of relevant experience in social media marketing, digital marketing, content creation, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience managing branded social media accounts and developing platform\-specific content.
* Strong photography, videography, video\-editing, and social\-first copywriting skills.

**About the Team**
------------------



DoorDash for Business (DDfB) is one of DoorDash's fastest\-growing businesses, helping organizations engage and support their employees through meal benefits, workplace catering, gifting, and other workplace solutions. As companies invest in employee engagement and return\-to\-office initiatives, we're expanding our product offerings, launching internationally, and building toward a one\-stop solution for corporate workplace needs. Joining this team means joining a startup within DoorDash \- you'll have the ownership and speed of a high\-growth business backed by the scale, resources, and brand of a global leader.


**About the Role**
------------------



We're looking for an Inbound Sales Development Representative to join our DoorDash for Business team, focused on converting inbound interest into qualified pipeline within Mid Market to Strategic accounts. You'll work inbound leads within SLA, quickly assessing fit and intent before they ever reach an Account Executive. As DDfB's first line of communication for prospects who've already raised their hand, you'll shape their first impression of us and run structured discovery conversations that set our sales team up for success. You'll also take on periodic outbound\-oriented projects tied to DoorDash for Business growth and GTM testing, using our existing playbook.



You will report into the Business Development Manager in our pre\-sales organization.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* Own inbound leads from the moment they hit your queue, working within defined SLAs to make first contact, qualify, and route \- speed and responsiveness are the job, not a nice\-to\-have
* Qualify inbound interest against clear criteria\- and just as importantly, disqualify quickly and cleanly so sales time goes to the accounts worth pursuing
* Run structured discovery on inbound conversations to understand intent and need, then hand off well\-briefed, sales\-ready meetings to Account Executives
* Take on side projects tied to DDfB growth and GTM testing — new channel experiments, campaign tests, and initiatives that pull on outbound prospecting and multi\-touch outreach skills alongside your core inbound work
* Partner closely with Account Executives and Marketing to close the loop on lead quality, surfacing patterns in what's converting (and what isn't) back to the team

* You have a track record of meeting or exceeding activity, SLA and conversion pipeline goals in a quota\-driven environment
* You can quickly assess fit and intent on a lead — and you're comfortable disqualifying as confidently as you qualify
* You are proficient with sales tools such as Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Outreach, and use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to support process, qualification and prospecting
* You're adaptable \- equally comfortable reacting fast to an inbound queue and picking up structured outbound work when a growth or GTM test calls for it
* You have a resilient, gritty mindset and thrive navigating complexity and ambiguity in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment


Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis

Pamella Roland is a New York\-based luxury fashion house known for sophisticated eveningwear, cocktail attire, and occasion dressing. Since its debut in 2002, the brand has become recognized for exceptional craftsmanship, intricate embellishment, and glamorous design, dressing notable women for the runway, red carpet and special occasions.

Pamella Roland is seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented DesignDevelopment Assistant to support the Design team throughout the seasonal development process, from initial prototypes through handoff to Production.


This role combines creative and operational responsibilities, with a focus on samples, fittings, materials, and product information. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of garment development and enjoys the hands\-on process of bringing luxury eveningwear from design concept to finished product.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and track prototypes and development samples, including shipments to and from vendors.
* Maintain the development calendar and track key deadlines, sample dates and delays.
* Maintain accurate product and development information throughout the season.
* Create and update tech packs with style information, sketches and development notes.

* Manage development trims and linings, including ordering, tracking and maintaining stock.

* Work closely with Design, Patternmaking/Technical and Production teams.

* Bachelor's degree in Fashion Design, Product Development or related field preferred.

* Familiarity with tech packs, BOMs and sample development.
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and Canva.
* Strong Microsoft Excel and general computer skills.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and shifting deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience with luxury womenswear, eveningwear, embroidery, embellishment or specialty fabrics is a plus.

Founder \& Leadership Support

* Managing sensitive and confidential information with a high level of discretion and judgement.
* Helping reduce unnecessary noise around the Founder by acting as an effective gatekeeper and filtering requests according to priority and business need.


Travel \& Logistics

Events, Shoots \& On\-Site Support

* Supporting the Founder at business events, shoots, launches, meetings and other key Oner Active moments as required.

* Ensuring the Founder’s schedule remains on track during high\-pressure or fast\-moving business days.

Administrative \& Communication Duties

* Acting as a key point of contact for employees and external stakeholders seeking access to the Founder.
* Coordinating business gifting, couriers, shipments and other ad\-hoc business logistics.

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Healthcare, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* 2 years of experience handling workers compensation claims.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience with claims management systems, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS) platforms, and standard productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets).
* Solid working knowledge of end\-to\-end workers compensation procedures, claims administration, and relevant state and federal labor laws.
* Comprehensive understanding of medical terminology, treatment protocols, and injury evaluation.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Workers Compensation and Owner Controlled Insurance Policy (OCIP) Program Lead oversees the strategic governance, placement, and daily administration of owner\-controlled insurance programs and occupational injury claims. This role drives end\-to\-end risk management by conducting exposure analyses, directing policy audits, and partnering closely with brokers and contractors to optimize coverage structures and ensure seamless program enrollment.


In addition to program strategy, the lead directs full\-lifecycle workers compensation claims management across employees, owners, and contractors. Acting as the primary liaison among injured workers, insurance carriers, legal counsel, and healthcare providers, the role coordinates quality medical care and facilitates prompt, modified\-duty return\-to\-work transitions. Furthermore, the position ensures regulatory compliance and workplace safety by delivering supervisor training, maintaining comprehensive claims databases, and analyzing incident trends to implement proactive, data\-driven injury prevention initiatives.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead end\-to\-end insurance placement and strategic risk mitigation across all operations. Manage data processing for policy placement, oversee policy audits, analyze program structures, and direct enrollments with OCIP brokers and contractors.
* Receive and process claims for owners, employees, and contractors, arrange medical care and facilitate return\-to\-work and modified\-duty accommodations.
* Serve as primary contact for injured workers, liaise with carriers, clinics, and legal counsel and maintain detailed incidents and financial records.
* Deliver supervisors claim training, analyze incident trends to prevent recurring injuries, and ensure alignment with workers compensation regulations.
* Evaluate risk exposures, design proactive risk control solutions, and build strategic vendor and insurer relationships.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.title: TPS Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever\-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------


The Treasury and Payments Solutions (TPS) Event Coordinator manages the execution and operational support of trade shows, conferences, bank\-hosted Client Advisory Groups, and employee events. The role coordinates attendee registration and communications, invitations, meeting and session logistics, rooming lists, shipping and material handling, venues, vendors, production partners, event timelines, project plans, budget tracking, invoicing, contracts, and onsite support.


The role also supports event reporting, participation tracking, meeting management, feedback and lead capture, campaign attribution, and post\-event analytics, using Salesforce and other event technologies where appropriate. Working across Sales, Marketing, Product, Strategy, and internal event partners, the coordinator helps maintain accurate data, enables timely follow\-up, improves event processes, and delivers a consistent participant experience across external client and internal employee events.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Event Execution \& Operations (60%)**

* Manage end\-to\-end execution of trade shows, conferences, bank\-hosted Client Advisory Groups, and employee events.
* Coordinate event logistics, including invitations, attendee registration and communications, agendas and session support, meeting logistics, rooming lists, shipping and material handling, venue coordination, and vendor management.
* Support multiple large\-scale events simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
* Manage event timelines, project plans, and execution deliverables.
* Serve as onsite support for priority trade shows, conferences, Client Advisory Groups, and employee events.
* Manage event vendors, venues, sponsorship partners, facilitators, and production partners appropriate to each event type.
* Support budget tracking and reconciliation, coordinate invoicing and payment processes, and maintain event\-related contracts and documentation.

**Salesforce, Reporting \& Pipeline Support (25%)**

* Serve as the primary Salesforce resource for applicable external event and conference reporting, while supporting participation and engagement reporting for Client Advisory Groups and employee events.
* Support audience identification, attendee targeting, invitation, registration, and communication processes across client and employee events.
* Partner with event strategy, client advocacy, and business stakeholders to track meeting activity, participant feedback, commitments, and post\-event follow\-up.
* Work with digital marketing and internal partners to maintain dashboards or reporting that measure participation and engagement across event types.
* Track opportunity influence and pipeline generation for applicable external events, and participation, engagement, and follow\-up measures for Client Advisory Groups and employee events.
* Produce post\-event analytics and reporting to support business reviews, Client Advisory Group follow\-up, and employee event assessment.
* Ensure accurate campaign attribution, meeting capture, participation tracking, and feedback documentation processes, as applicable.

**Meeting Management \& Lead Capture (10%)**

* Manage meeting and session scheduling, confirmations, agendas, participant communications, and logistics.
* Oversee lead, feedback, question, and participation capture processes, including the use of Captello and other event technologies as appropriate.
* Ensure meeting, lead, feedback, and participation data is captured accurately and shared appropriately for follow\-up.
* Partner with event strategy and client advocacy stakeholders to maximize client engagement and support effective employee participation.

**Process Improvement \& Team Support (5%)**

* Maintain event playbooks, templates, and standard operating procedures.
* Identify opportunities to streamline execution and improve client, guest, and employee participant experiences.
* Support cross\-functional coordination among Sales, Marketing, Product, Leadership, client advocacy, communications, and employee event partners.

**Measurement \& Impact**


Impact will be reflected through reliable execution across trade shows, conferences, bank\-hosted Client Advisory Groups, and employee events; accurate reporting and attribution; timely follow\-up on meetings, leads, feedback, and commitments; effective operational controls; and continuous improvement of participant experiences.

* On\-time completion of event timelines, project plans, logistics, and execution deliverables
* Accuracy of Salesforce campaign attribution, meeting capture, lead and feedback data, participation tracking, dashboards, and post\-event reporting, as applicable
* Effective budget tracking, reconciliation, invoicing, payment processing, contract management, and documentation
* Timely coordination of meeting activity, Client Advisory Group commitments, participant feedback, and post\-event follow\-up
* Consistent use and improvement of event playbooks, templates, and standard operating procedures

**Success Profile**

* Exceptional attention to detail while supporting multiple large\-scale events and concurrent priorities
* Strong partnership across Sales, Marketing, Product, Leadership, digital marketing, client advocacy, communications, and employee event teams
* Accurate, timely reporting, campaign management, analytics, meeting capture, lead and feedback

jobs.title: Development Coordinator (Raiser's Edge Expert)
jobs.description:
**High Meadows School and Camp \| Roswell, Georgia**  
**Full\-time \| 12\-month \| 40 hours/week \| Non\-exempt**

Due to an internal promotion, High Meadows School and Camp is seeking a **Development Coordinator** to join our Development team. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys organization, data, details, as well as the creative side of coordinating Development events, mailings, invitations, and being the person behind the scenes who helps everything come together.

Working closely with the Director of Development, the Development Coordinator helps keep the day\-to\-day work of Development organized, accurate, and moving forward. From maintaining donor records and processing gifts to supporting fundraising campaigns and coordinating Development events, this person plays an important role in helping High Meadows build and strengthen relationships across our community.

**What You'll Do**

* As resident Raiser’s Edge expert, you will manage and maintain our Raiser’s Edge donor database, keeping constituent, donor, gift, pledge, and prospect information accurate and up to date
* Process gifts, pledges, and recurring contributions and prepare acknowledgments, tax receipts, pledge reminders, and donor correspondence
* Create reports, mailing lists, donor segments, data merges, and giving analyses to support fundraising and stewardship efforts
* Partner with the Finance team to reconcile gifts and maintain accurate Development and financial records
* Keep Development projects, deadlines, calendars, files, procedures, and tracking systems organized
* Coordinate Development mailings and provide administrative and project support for fundraising campaigns, donor stewardship, alumni engagement, and other Development initiatives
* Assist the Director of Development with donor research, meeting preparation, reports, presentations, correspondence, and special projects
* Plan and coordinate Development Department events and donor gatherings in collaboration with the Director of Development and Events Manager, including invitations, guest and donor lists, RSVPs, communications, fundraising or auction records, event details, and post\-event follow\-up
* Work collaboratively with the Events Manager on Development events, with both positions contributing to the planning, coordination, and successful execution of these events
* Collaborate with Marketing \& Communications to help ensure Development information and messaging are accurate, timely, and consistent
* Pitch in on other Development projects and priorities as they arise

**You Might Be a Great Fit If You...**

· Are highly organized and genuinely enjoy keeping details straight

· Like working with data, spreadsheets, databases, reports, and systems

· Enjoy coordinating events and seeing the details come together

· Can manage several priorities and deadlines without losing track of the small things

· Take ownership of your work and follow through

· Communicate warmly and professionally with donors, families, volunteers, colleagues, and other members of the School community

· Are comfortable handling confidential donor, family, and financial information with discretion

· Enjoy working independently while also being part of a collaborative team

· Can adjust when priorities change and still keep things moving

· Are willing to jump in, solve problems, and help where needed

**What You'll Bring**

Experience with Raiser’s Edge is required for this position. Experience with Veracross is helpful, as is strong proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel. You should also be comfortable working with donor data, reports, spreadsheets, gift records, and financial information.

We'd also like to see approximately three to five years of relevant experience in areas such as Development/fundraising, database administration, nonprofit or school operations, or administrative support. Prior experience supporting fundraising operations, donor relations, gift processing, Development programs, or Development\-related events strongly preferred.

A bachelor's degree is preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

**What Success Looks Like**

Our Development Coordinator is someone people can count on. You'll know the donor data, understand the systems, anticipate deadlines, catch details, and help keep Development initiatives moving throughout the year.

You'll also be comfortable moving between very different kinds of work—perhaps preparing a donor report one day, processing gifts the next, and then working alongside the Director of Development and Events Manager to coordinate an upcoming donor gathering.

Success at High Meadows means being curious, collaborative, dependable, and willing to take initiative. We're looking for someone who wants to understand the School and Camp as a whole, builds positive relationships across departments, and takes pride in the behind\-the\-scenes work that helps Development and the broader High Meadows community succeed.

**A Little About High Meadows**

High Meadows School and Camp is located on 42 wooded acres in Roswell, Georgia, about 30 minutes north of Atlanta. Our campus includes multiple buildings, meadows, forest, and an active barnyard—so working here doesn't always look like working in a traditional office.

High Meadows offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision coverage; school\-paid life and long\-term disability insurance; a 403(b) retirement plan with up to a 4% school match; paid leave; and a tuition discount for children attending High Meadows School.

**Apply**

Please apply via our school website, www.highmeadows.org, About Us, Working at High Meadows, then scroll down to Active Vacancies. Once you click on a vacancy, you click “Apply Now”.

Questions? Email HR Manager Jane Murphy at **jmurphy@highmeadows.org.** If you are selected for the next steps in the process, you will be contacted directly.

*High Meadows School and Camp

**POSITION SUMMARY:**


Person in this position will be responsible for providing support, outreach, and engagement services to veterans and service members at risk of suicide. Utilizing lived experience and trauma\-informed care, the specialist builds trust with participants, connects them to essential services, and promotes hope, recovery, and wellness. Essential functions include those listed below.


**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Conduct community outreach and engagement activities to identify and connect with at\-risk veterans and service members.
* Provide support and mentorship using shared lived experience to foster trust and empowerment.
* Assist individuals in navigating mental health and substance use services, housing resources, crisis intervention, and other support systems.
* Collaborate with local VA facilities, community providers, and the broader support network to coordinate services and referrals.
* Participate in suicide prevention trainings and maintain knowledge of best practices related to veteran care.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of all interactions and services provided, in compliance with grant requirements and confidentiality standards.
* Support follow\-up efforts with program participants to ensure continued engagement and service connection.
* Promote protective factors such as connectedness, resilience, and purpose among participants.
* Attend and participate in team meetings, supervision, and relevant community events.
* Must Embrace and embody the mission, vision, guiding principles, clinical vision, and goals of WestCare Foundation; and
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

**ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS:**

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the duties and responsibilities satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.*

***Experience and Competencies:***

* Strong interpersonal, engagement, advocacy, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to organize and prioritize a caseload, coordinate multiple services, and complete documentation timely.
* Ability to communicate effectively with participants, families, providers, community partners, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Sound judgment, problem\-solving ability, and the ability to respond appropriately to urgent participant needs.
* Basic computer proficiency and ability to use electronic records, databases, email, and standard office applications.
* Excellent communication skills;
* Ability to exercise good judgment and discretion;
* Ability to work well in a team environment;
* Military/Veteran status required.
* Adherence to the highest standard of ethical conduct, especially to standards governing confidentiality;
* Professional appearance and demeanor;
* Valid driver’s license and ability to obtain and maintain WestCare’s vehicle insurance is required; and
* Ability to obtain and maintain a criminal history background check.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:**

* Minimum of two (2\) years of experience of relevant experience.
* Experience working with high\-risk populations, including individuals experiencing mental health and/or substance use disorders.
* Knowledge of suicide prevention principles, trauma\-informed care, community resources, and challenges affecting veterans and service members.

**LICENSURE/CERTIFICATION:**

* Not applicable for this position.

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

* Work is primarily performed in an office setting.
* Regular travel throughout the assigned service area is required to support outreach, community partnerships, participant services, meetings, and program activities.
* Travel between WestCare facilities, VA facilities, community partner locations, and outreach sites may be required.
* Position requires regular interaction with Veterans and individuals who may be experiencing behavioral health concerns, emotional distress, significant psychosocial stressors, or suicide risk.
* Some evening or weekend work may be required to support outreach events, community activities, or program needs.

jobs.title: Event Coordinator - Atlanta
jobs.description:
**Event Coordinator**
=====================

**S.A.F.E. Management**  

**The Job**  


S.A.F.E. Management staffs and operates event security and guest services at nearly 70 venues across 11 markets and 10 states. That includes major NFL and college stadiums in Las Vegas, Phoenix, Houston, Nashville, Atlanta, Jacksonville, Tampa, Baltimore, Detroit, Newark, and Denver. On a busy weekend we have 20,000 team members working live events around the country.  


The Event Coordinator is a key player in the success of these events. You will help build the staffing plan, brief the team, proactively engage staff during the event, handle event\-day operations, and represent S.A.F.E. in front of the client.  


This is a hands\-on operations role for someone who aspires to grow in the sports \& entertainment industry.  

**What You'll Do:**  

**Run Events*** Work directly with clients to gather event details, staffing requirements, and day\-of expectations
* Build and update event\-day documentation, post assignments, and staffing plans
* Monitor venue operations during events to assess staffing levels, coverage, and performance against S.A.F.E. standards
* Solve day\-of problems quickly: call\-offs, gate changes, crowd flow, client requests, weather, unique event operations
* Brief the team prior to the start of the event and assist with debriefing afterward so the next event runs better

  

**Build the Team*** Participate in the recruiting process, including sourcing, applicant tracking, and interview scheduling
* Support critical teammate trainings such as, New Hire, Returning Staff, and Leadership trainings
* Handle staff questions in real time, on and off site
* Set the tone on professionalism and accountability that the team follows

 **Run the Back End**
Strong operators are organized operators and this sets the tone for game and event day.* Create and schedule events in our workforce management platform
* Submit and reconcile crew calls accurately in the timekeeping system
* Invoice completed events promptly and accurately
* Respond to office calls and emails within a timely manner
* Maintain clear, organized event documentation so another team member can step in and run the event if needed

 **Who We're Looking For*** Bachelor's degree
* 0 to 5 years of experience out of school
* A track record of competing on a team. Athletics, a campus organization, or an early job where your performance was measured and other people depended on you
* Ability to work efficiently in a fast\-paced, time\-sensitive environment
* Ability to communicate in front of a crowd and to senior\-level leadership
* Detail oriented, proficient with Microsoft Office, and the ability to quickly to pick up new systems
* Available nights, weekends, and holidays as our schedule follows the entertainment and events calendar
* Passionate about sports and live entertainment industry

 **Why S.A.F.E.**
We operate nearly 70 venues in 11 markets across 10 states, with the vision to continue to grow. This creates real responsibility early in your career. It also means a track to grow with S.A.F.E. is available for those who want it: coordinators can cross\-train at other venues in the portfolio and move up to manager with strong performance, managers can go on to eventually run venues.  

**We offer:*** Health insurance, 401(k) with company match, and paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Direct exposure to venue leadership, clients, and league/event\- level operations
* A career track across a national portfolio

 **Schedule**
Standard office hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with flexibility required for evening and weekend events, trainings, and interviews. This position reports directly to the respective market’s Managing Director. *We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.*

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us and Why We're Hiring**
---------------------------------


RoadSync powers commerce anywhere, anytime across the logistics ecosystem, with financial tools that are smart, simple, and fast. Our platform cuts processing time and puts more revenue back in the hands of warehouses, carriers, and repair and tow operators. As Pacesetter's fastest\-growing private company two years running, we're not slowing down. We're looking for top\-tier talent to keep us moving.


RoadSync is growing, and so is our Customer Success team. As our Account Manager, you'll own a portfolio of existing customers from day one: building relationships, driving product adoption, and protecting the business we've already won. If you're goal\-oriented, curious, and energized by owning your book of business, let's talk.

### **About this role:**


To join us as our Account Manager, you've worked in Account Management, Customer Success, or Relationship Management, ideally at a B2B or B2B2C technology, SaaS, or Fintech company. You know how to manage a portfolio, spot risk before it becomes churn, and turn a good customer conversation into a measurable next step.

#### **Some things you'll be doing at RoadSync…**

* Own and grow relationships across your assigned portfolio of customer accounts
* Run proactive outreach focused on engagement, retention, adoption, and growth
* Spot declining usage and other churn signals early, and build a plan to fix it
* Find expansion and cross\-sell opportunities tied to what each customer actually needs
* Show customers how our products improve their payment and operational workflows
* Lead regular check\-ins and business reviews to track goals, challenges, and opportunities
* Ask for referrals and earn them
* Handle escalations with clear, direct communication through resolution
* Keep your CRM sharp: accurate notes, follow\-ups, and opportunity tracking
* Partner with Implementation, Sales, Support, Product, and Operations to get customers what they need
* Hit your numbers, individually and as a team

#### **We'd love to hear from you if you have…**

* 2\+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Relationship Management, Sales, or a similar customer\-facing role
* Experience owning a portfolio or book of business
* Strong relationship\-building and communication skills
* The instinct to connect a customer's need to the right product, before they ask
* Comfort discussing account performance and growth directly with customers
* Sharp organization, prioritization, and follow\-through
* The ability to juggle multiple accounts and priorities without dropping the ball.

###### **And a few things that are a "plus":**

* Experience with CRM platforms like HubSpot
* Experience in payments, fintech, transportation, trucking, towing, repair, or logistics

##### **What Success Looks Like**


A successful Account Manager owns their book of business. You know which customers need attention, where the risks are, and where the growth is. Every customer conversation has a purpose and leads somewhere.


You build real relationships without losing your commercial edge. Customer success means helping customers win while growing the partnership.

##### **Ideal Candidate**


You're proactive, organized, and accountable. You don't wait for customers to come to you, you spot the need first. You ask good questions, follow through on what you say you'll do, and bring a problem\-solving mindset to every conversation. You like clear goals, and you know exactly how your work drives retention, revenue, and the team's success.

### **Why you'll love it here...**


RoadSync is a team of researchers, sellers, builders, marketers, designers, and operators, all driven by one thing: our customers. We put in the work because we care about getting it right. We're proud of the diverse team we've built, because it's what makes us better.

#### **Here's what's in it for you:**

* Competitive pay and company equity from day one
* Medical, dental, and vision, premiums paid for employees
* Three weeks (15 days) of PTO annually
* An energetic office in Midtown Atlanta
* Mentorship from leaders across the company
* 401(k) plan
* Parking covered while you're in the office
* Catered lunches for the in\-office crew
* Full visibility into how the company runs and why it matters

 *RoadSync is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and an Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, creed, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression, age, height, weight, veteran status, military obligations, pregnancy, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. Every day our team is honored to work with individuals from all walks of life. We aim to build a team that reflects the diversity of our customers. Each individual at RoadSync brings their own perspectives, work experiences, lifestyles, and cultures with them. We believe that a more diverse team creates more innovative products, provides a better service to our customers and helps us grow and learn as individuals.*
